job.title: Test Engineer
job.description:
Test Engineer

Overview

Join a Product Software QA team working on a mission-critical web application that supports autonomous vehicle operations. As a Test Engineer, you will help ensure reliable, high-quality releases through a combination of automated and manual testing. You’ll develop and maintain Playwright-based test cases, contribute to test strategy and release validation, and collaborate with developers, QA leads, and product managers across multiple environments. This is an opportunity to contribute to software testing within a complex, safety-critical technology environment.

Required Skills

  • 1–4 years of experience as a Test Engineer
  • Proven experience testing large-scale, complex applications
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright automation
  • Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Strong working knowledge of testing and issue-tracking tools, including:
  • JIRA
  • TestRail
  • Ability to develop and execute test strategies and test plans for new features
  • Experience creating, maintaining, and expanding automated test cases
  • Experience performing manual testing for feature releases, hotfixes, and pre-merge validations
  • Ability to document test results, maintain requirements traceability, and track issues through resolution
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills when working with developers, QA leads, and product managers

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with release validation across multiple environments
  • Experience conducting mission or field testing and analyzing test outcomes
  • Experience contributing to QA process improvements and test automation initiatives
  • Experience supporting testing for mission-critical or safety-critical software

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field
  • 1–4 years of professional Test Engineer experience

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite
  • Location: Foster City, CA
  • Employment type: W2 only
  • Duration: Approximately 6 months
  • Ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and support testing activities throughout the release lifecycle

job.title: Senior Technical Writer
job.description:
Senior Technical Writer

Overview

Support the future of manufacturing through clear, accurate, and actionable technical documentation. As a Senior Technical Writer, you will partner with engineers, technicians, quality teams, and operational leaders to create documentation that strengthens production quality, improves training effectiveness, and enhances manufacturing efficiency.

This role will focus on developing and managing work instructions, standard operating procedures, training materials, process and equipment documentation, quality specifications, process diagrams, and safety guidelines. You will also help advance documentation workflows, templates, tracking systems, and standards while serving as a trusted resource for stakeholders and fellow technical writers.

Required Skills

  • 10–15 years of experience in technical writing, preferably within manufacturing, automotive, engineering, or similarly complex technical environments
  • Expert knowledge of Oxygen XML Author, including reusable content, facets, filters, conditional formatting, and related implementation features
  • Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Engineering, or a related field
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accurate, and user-friendly content
  • Experience authoring, editing, updating, and managing:
  • Work instructions
  • Standard operating procedures
  • Training manuals
  • Product, process, and equipment documentation
  • Quality specifications
  • Process diagrams
  • Safety guidelines
  • Experience collaborating with engineers, technicians, quality teams, and operational leaders
  • Familiarity with compliance-driven documentation and standards such as ISO and APQP
  • Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills
  • Ability to manage and report on multiple documentation projects simultaneously
  • Experience working with style guides, templates, documentation standards, and structured content workflows
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to provide project updates to stakeholders
  • Ability to support workflow development and process improvement initiatives
  • Experience using Git and supporting documentation workflows in Oxygen

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience developing training programs or applying instructional design principles
  • Familiarity with Jira and Confluence
  • Experience with Dozuki, Adobe tools, or other collaboration and documentation platforms
  • Familiarity with 3DX or CAD visualization tools
  • Experience creating technician-focused, step-by-step training content with visuals
  • Experience using dashboards and tracking tools to monitor documentation progress and identify improvement opportunities
  • Previous experience serving as a team lead, documentation lead, or point of contact for cross-functional projects

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Engineering, or a related discipline
  • 10–15 years of professional technical writing experience
  • Background supporting manufacturing operations, automotive production, engineering, quality, or other compliance-focused technical environments

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid
  • Location: Foster City, CA
  • Occasional travel to various locations may be required to support manufacturing operations teams
  • Ability to work effectively with engineers, technicians, quality professionals, and operational leadership
  • Ability to follow strict documentation standards while helping improve templates, workflows, tracking systems, and the broader documentation framework
  • Employment type: W2 only

job.title: Senior Payroll Administrator
job.description:
Senior Payroll Administrator (Hybrid / Remote Option on Pacific Time)

Location: Palo Alto, CA (Hybrid – ~2-3 days/week) or Remote (Pacific Time)

Company: Confidential Medical Device / Healthcare Technology Company

Department: Finance & Accounting

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Opportunity

We are partnering with a high-growth, globally backed medical device company headquartered in Palo Alto to find a Senior Payroll Administrator.

Reporting directly to the Assistant Controller, this role sits squarely within the Finance and Accounting organization and owns end-to-end U.S. payroll operations for a dynamic, scaling employee base. This is not just a transactional processing role; it is a critical opportunity for a process-builder to partner with cross-functional teams, drive operational cleanup, implement system best practices, and contribute to an ongoing payroll and compliance modernization journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Payroll Operations: Own and execute bi-weekly, monthly, and special payroll runs for approximately 265+ U.S. employees (including hourly, salaried, and international expatriate populations) across 30+ states.
  • Compliance & Tax Governance: Ensure flawless multi-state tax compliance, manage garnishments, oversee supplemental tax rates, track regulatory updates (including Secure 2.0), and collaborate with external providers to resolve tax notices and multi-jurisdictional registrations.
  • Accounting & General Ledger Integration: Partner closely with accounting to prepare payroll-related journal entries, manage balance sheet account reconciliations, support monthly/quarterly/yearly close cycles, and ensure clean GL mapping within ADP and ERP systems.
  • Audit & Benefit Administration: Lead payroll-related preparation and support for annual audits, including Workers' Compensation, 401(k) plans, and financial audits. Ensure accurate benefit premium calculations and FSA/401(k) funding.
  • Process Improvement & Documentation: Act as a change agent by building out robust standard operating procedures (SOPs), cleaning up historical data, automating manual workflows, and optimizing ADP Workforce Now configurations.
  • Internal Customer Support: Serve as a trusted, communicative resource for employees across the organization, providing clear guidance on payroll timelines, earnings, and policies while maintaining strict discretion over confidential data.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Minimum 7–8+ years of progressive, multi-state payroll processing experience in fast-paced environments (diversity of company types and hands-on operational exposure preferred).
  • Technical Mastery: Advanced, hands-on proficiency with ADP Workforce Now (system setup, troubleshooting, and configuration—not just data entry).
  • Compliance Expertise: Deep understanding of multi-state payroll regulations, overtime, meal penalties, regular rate of pay, supplemental tax rates, and tax compliance.
  • Accounting Acumen: Solid foundational accounting skills with a strong understanding of debits, credits, journal entries, and general ledger reconciliation workflows.
  • The Builder Mindset: A proactive, assertive, and tactful professional who thrives on process improvement, documentation, system cleanup, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, or HR, a Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation, or ADP Workforce Now certifications are highly preferred.
  • Location Flexibility: Candidates within 60 miles of Palo Alto are expected to work a hybrid schedule (~2–3 days/week onsite). Strong remote candidates based on Pacific Time outside of the Bay Area will also be considered.

What’s in It for You?

  • Competitive Compensation: Base salary range of $110,000 – $130,000+ (depending on experience and location) plus strong comprehensive benefits.
  • Visibility & Impact: A high-visibility role within a stable, globally backed organization experiencing major commercial growth and roadmap milestones.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunity to expand scope (including potential oversight of T&E functions) and be a foundational pillar in modernizing the company's financial infrastructure.



DeWinter Group and Maris Consulting is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We post pay scales which are based on our client pay ranges. DeWinter, Maris, and our clients have the right to modify the requirements of the role which can impact the pay ranges posted.

job.title: Frontend Developer - Design Systems
job.description:
Frontend Developer – Design Systems

Overview

Build the foundation behind a suite of modern applications as a Frontend Developer – Design Systems. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented frontend engineer who cares deeply about how interfaces look, feel, and perform—from precise spacing and interaction states to motion, accessibility, responsive behavior, and pixel-perfect implementation.

You’ll build and maintain React components ranging from foundational primitives to complex composite patterns, translating detailed Figma designs into production-ready code. You’ll partner closely with designers and engineers, provide thoughtful technical feedback, strengthen component testing and documentation, and help establish the guardrails that make AI-assisted development reliable and scalable. Because the design system includes 3D experiences, experience with Three.js is highly valued.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain reusable React components for a shared design system.
  • Translate detailed Figma specifications into accurate, responsive implementations.
  • Implement component states, transitions, animations, light and dark modes, and responsive behavior.
  • Review designs before implementation, identify potential issues, and recommend solutions that protect the design vision.
  • Contribute to Storybook by writing stories, maintaining documentation, and improving usability for consuming engineers.
  • Write component tests with Vitest and Testing Library.
  • Develop end-to-end and visual regression coverage with Playwright as part of CI workflows.
  • Use AI coding tools extensively while reviewing and refining every line of generated code.
  • Help develop prompts, rules, linting, type constraints, and review workflows that keep AI-generated code aligned with engineering standards.
  • Ensure components use design tokens consistently rather than hardcoded values.
  • Implement CSS animations, transitions, keyframes, and WebGL experiences where appropriate.
  • Collaborate daily with designers and engineers, participate in code reviews, and shepherd focused pull requests through completion.
  • Maintain a high standard of visual and technical quality across the design system.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • At least 4 years of frontend development experience.
  • Significant experience working on a component library or design system.
  • Deep expertise with JavaScript and React, including:
  • Composition patterns
  • React hooks
  • Component performance
  • Reusable component API design
  • Advanced CSS skills, including animations, transitions, responsive design, and interaction states.
  • Strong ability to implement highly detailed designs from Figma.
  • Experience reviewing design specifications, inspecting values, and identifying design intent.
  • Hands-on experience with software testing, including:
  • Vitest
  • Testing Library
  • Playwright
  • End-to-end and visual regression testing
  • Solid understanding of CI pipelines.
  • Experience with design tokens and approaches that support a consistent source of truth across platforms.
  • Extensive experience using AI coding tools, with the judgment to evaluate and correct their output.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to polished, pixel-accurate interfaces.
  • Ability to communicate technical opinions clearly, collaborate effectively, and thoughtfully challenge designs or implementation approaches when appropriate.
  • Experience partnering with designers and engineers throughout the development lifecycle.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Three.js, React Three Fiber, or similar React/Three.js technologies.
  • Working knowledge of MUI, including theming, overrides, and extensions.
  • Experience creating custom tooling around AI agents, including MCP servers, Skills, custom linting, or code generation.
  • Experience with WebGL.
  • Experience with code generation.
  • Exposure to iOS or Android design systems and development workflows.
  • Experience building or maintaining AI-assisted development workflows.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • A minimum of 4 years of professional frontend development experience is preferred.
  • Experience delivering and supporting production-grade design systems or component libraries is strongly preferred.
  • Formal educational requirements were not specified for this position.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid, with onsite work required Monday through Wednesday in Foster City, California.
  • Engagement: W2 only.
  • Contract duration: 6 months.
  • Start date: As soon as possible.
  • The role requires close collaboration with design and engineering partners and a strong commitment to precise, high-quality implementation.

job.title: Test Technician - QA
job.description:
Test Technician – QA

Overview

Help advance the future of autonomous mobility as a Test Technician – QA. In this onsite role, you will support vehicle operations, maintain high safety and readiness standards, and execute software and hardware testing in a dynamic, high-pressure environment. You will review test data, identify and document defects, communicate findings to engineering teams, and help refine the processes and tools that support safe, reliable vehicle operations.

This position offers hands-on exposure to vehicle testing and the operational complexities of autonomous mobility. You will collaborate with teams spanning computer vision, infrastructure, sound design, strategy, vehicle engineering, and ride operations while contributing to a safety-focused, inclusive, and open-communication culture.

Required Skills

  • 2–5 years of experience, including at least 2 years conducting complex testing or vehicle testing
  • Basic QA testing experience
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency with JIRA and Confluence, or comparable tools such as Azure DevOps
  • Ability to analyze vehicle logs and test data to help trace failures and support root-cause analysis
  • Experience documenting defects, creating tickets, and communicating issues to engineering teams
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented mindset
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to perform effectively in high-pressure situations
  • Safety-first mindset, sense of urgency, and a “get it done” attitude
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate documentation

Nice to Have Skills

  • Python or other programming experience
  • Scripting experience with a high-level language, such as Python
  • Experience with issue reporting and defect management tools
  • Familiarity with communication buses, including CAN or Ethernet
  • Experience supporting vehicle operations or mission preparation
  • Experience with software and hardware configuration verification
  • Exposure to autonomous vehicle, robotics, automotive, or other complex technical testing environments

Preferred Education and Experience

  • At least 2 years of experience running complex software, hardware, QA, or vehicle testing
  • Experience working in an operational, technical, automotive, robotics, or comparable testing environment is preferred
  • Educational requirements were not specified for this position

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully onsite in Las Vegas, Nevada
  • Schedule: Saturday through Wednesday or Thursday through Monday
  • Shift availability: Day, swing, or graveyard shifts; schedules may include early mornings, evenings, overnights, and weekends
  • Must be able to support operational demands and work assigned shifts
  • Must be able to perform mission preparation activities, including launching software across multiple vehicle devices, verifying software and hardware configurations, deploying software as appropriate, and capturing requested data
  • Must be able to support vehicle operations and a range of roles in and outside vehicles
  • Must be able to provide accurate written and verbal feedback, assist with documentation and metrics, and support defect management from identification through resolution
  • Must be able to follow safety procedures and escalate issues appropriately
  • W2 engagement only
  • Six-month contract duration
  • Immediate start required

job.title: Senior Billing / AR Analyst
job.description:
Senior Billing / AR Analyst

Overview

Take ownership of critical billing and accounts receivable operations within a high-growth SaaS/software environment. As the Senior Billing / AR Analyst, you will manage the full billing lifecycle, oversee collections and cash application, resolve complex discrepancies, and help strengthen quote-to-cash processes. This role is ideal for an analytical, systems-savvy professional who can partner effectively across Finance, Sales, Legal, Deal Operations, and IT while driving accuracy, scalability, and continuous improvement.

This is an immediate contract opportunity expected to last approximately 4–6 months, with potential for extension and possible conversion to a permanent position based on performance.

Required Skills

  • 4–6 years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, or revenue accounting within a high-growth SaaS or software company
  • Strong experience with the NetSuite billing module
  • Experience managing Salesforce-to-NetSuite data flows; Salesforce and NetSuite experience are required
  • Knowledge of full-cycle billing, including customer setup, amendments, terminations, invoicing, and discrepancy resolution
  • Experience supporting subscription, usage-based, milestone, and professional services billing models
  • Strong understanding of accounts receivable aging, collections, cash application, reconciliations, credit memos, refunds, and payment disputes
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and analysis of large data sets
  • Demonstrated success identifying process gaps and implementing workflow improvements or automation
  • Ability to support month-end close activities, including accruals, adjustments, reconciliations, and financial flux analysis
  • Familiarity with ASC 606, revenue recognition policies, and audit-ready documentation
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with Finance, Sales, Legal, Deal Operations, IT, and leadership

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with usage-based or consumption billing
  • Exposure to SOX controls and internal audit processes
  • Experience supporting publicly traded and privately held companies
  • Experience in both SaaS/software and other high-growth business environments
  • Familiarity with Stripe, Freshserve, or comparable billing and payment platforms
  • Experience developing AR dashboards and reporting on DSO, collection efficiency, aging trends, and other KPIs
  • Background creating standard operating procedures and scaling quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience using automation or emerging technology to reduce manual billing and AR work

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 4–6 years of relevant billing, accounts receivable, revenue accounting, or related finance experience is preferred
  • Experience working in a high-growth SaaS or software organization is strongly preferred
  • Experience supporting both publicly traded and privately held companies is beneficial
  • Specific educational requirements were not provided

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement is open to remote, onsite, or hybrid options
  • Ability to work primarily within your local time zone
  • Comfortable reporting to a Senior Accounting Manager and working independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Must be able to manage sensitive financial information with accuracy, discretion, and sound judgment
  • Contract engagement is expected to last approximately 4–6 months, with potential for extension and possible contract-to-hire consideration
  • Availability to begin as soon as possible is preferred

job.title: Accounting Manager
job.description:
Accounting Manager
Boston, MA Hybrid
Requirements

  • Active CPA certification
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including supervisory responsibilities
  • Prior law firm or professional services industry experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP, financial reporting, internal controls, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes
  • Demonstrated experience managing external audits, accounting operations, and financial reporting processes
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modeling, PivotTables, and data analysis
  • Experience working within a multi-office and international business environment
  • Strong project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills to interact effectively with firm leadership, attorneys, auditors, banking partners, and business professionals

Preferred

  • Partnership accounting experience
  • Experience managing treasury operations, banking relationships, and covenant compliance reporting
  • Advanced proficiency with ERP and financial management systems (Workday, UKG, Aderant, QuickBooks, FRx, SQL, Crystal Reports)

Job Description The Accounting Manager is responsible for overseeing the Firm's general accounting operations, month-end and year-end close processes, treasury activities, financial reporting support, audit coordination, and accounting controls. This role manages a team of accounting professionals, ensures the accuracy and integrity of the Firm's financial records, and serves as a key partner to Finance leadership in maintaining a scalable and well-controlled accounting environment.

  • Team Leadership & Talent Development: Supervise, mentor, and develop Staff and Senior Accountants; assign workloads, conduct performance reviews, provide technical accounting guidance, and manage close calendars and departmental deadlines.
  • Accounting Operations & Close Management: Oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes; review and approve journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, monthly close packages, and general ledger fluctuations in compliance with GAAP and internal controls.
  • Treasury & Banking Management: Oversee daily cash management, cash flow analyses, payroll funding approvals, and client trust/treasury accounting; serve as the primary banking liaison and manage lines of credit and monthly/quarterly lender covenant compliance reporting.
  • Audit, Compliance & Financial Reporting: Lead the annual external audit and the Brown Rudnick Charitable Foundation audit as the primary point of contact; review audit workpapers and adjustments, and support quarterly/annual financial reporting packages for lenders, partners, and management.
  • Accounting Governance & Internal Controls: Review key GL reconciliations and suspense account activity, establish and maintain accounting policies and procedures, and strengthen the Firm's internal control framework.
  • Systems Oversight & Process Improvement: Oversee general ledger governance and chart of accounts maintenance; approve Workday and UKG GL changes/mappings, lead accounting system implementations and testing, and drive process automation and standardization.
  • Financial Analysis & Leadership Support: Review cash flow reporting and quarterly internal financial statements; partner with the Accounting Operations Senior Manager, Controller, and CFO on budgeting, forecasting, compensation reviews, international/multi-currency accounting, and cross-functional initiatives.

job.title: Supplier Quality Engineer – Sensors
job.description:
Supplier Quality Engineer – Sensors

Overview

Help shape the quality and performance of next-generation sensing systems as a Supplier Quality Engineer – Sensors. This onsite role will partner with engineering, manufacturing, quality teams, and suppliers to ensure world-class performance across prototype and production programs. You will assess supplier capability, improve manufacturability, support complex sensor and electromechanical assembly development, and drive continuous improvement throughout the supply base.

The ideal candidate is entrepreneurial, driven, energetic, detail-oriented, and team-focused, with the technical expertise to solve challenging supplier and manufacturing quality issues.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field
  • Experience with sensor development, testing, and manufacturing processes, including one or more of the following:
  • LiDAR
  • Camera systems
  • Radar
  • Experience manufacturing complex electromechanical and optomechanical assemblies
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes, including:
  • PCB and PCBA
  • Wire harnesses
  • Stamping
  • Mechanical assembly
  • Working knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)
  • Experience using structured problem-solving techniques, such as:
  • Six Sigma
  • 8D
  • Pareto charts
  • Regression analysis
  • ANOVA
  • Design of Experiments (DOE)
  • Fishbone analysis
  • Red-X
  • Is/Is Not analysis
  • Experience with quality analysis and control tools, including:
  • Process flow diagrams
  • Process FMEAs
  • Process control plans
  • Statistical Process Control (SPC)
  • Measurement System Analysis (MSA)
  • Process capability studies
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Ability to assess supplier capability and manufacturing readiness
  • Ability to manage product and process development activities with suppliers
  • Strong collaboration, communication, analytical, and organizational skills

Nice to Have Skills

  • Master’s degree in Engineering or a related field
  • Experience creating and improving quality systems
  • Working knowledge of ISO 9000 and IATF 16949 quality systems
  • ASQ certification
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
  • Experience in the automotive, aviation, computer, or medical device industries

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline; a master’s degree is preferred
  • 3–6 years of experience in Quality, Supplier Quality, or Manufacturing
  • Experience supporting prototype and production suppliers
  • Background in sensor, electromechanical, optomechanical, or complex assembly manufacturing

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Fremont, California
  • Potential travel outside the United States, including Mexico
  • W2 engagement only
  • Ability to review supplier quality documentation, provide technical feedback, issue corrective action requests, and support resolution
  • Ability to support Manufacturing, Quality, and Vehicle Engineering teams with the analysis and disposition of suspect supplier material
  • Ability to drive supplier continuous improvement using quality and lean manufacturing tools

job.title: Business Communications Manager
job.description:
Business Communications Manager

Overview

Join a collaborative Communications team helping bring organizational strategy, values, and priorities to life through clear, engaging communications. As a Business Communications Manager, you’ll serve as a strategic communications partner to business groups across the organization, translating complex initiatives and evolving programs into messages that connect employees to what matters most.

This role is ideal for a relationship-driven communications professional who can advise senior leaders, develop thoughtful communications strategies, and execute high-quality content in a dynamic environment. You’ll support organizational change, build trusted partnerships, and bring structure and fresh thinking to programs that are still taking shape.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a communications partner to assigned business groups, building trusted relationships with leaders and leadership teams.
  • Develop and manage end-to-end communications plans that connect business priorities to broader organizational strategy.
  • Lead communications for organizational change, including reorganizations, leadership transitions, program launches, and policy updates.
  • Advise stakeholders on communication strategy, timing, channels, and messaging.
  • Translate complex business initiatives into clear, compelling communications for a range of audiences.
  • Identify opportunities to improve communications processes and programs.
  • Manage multiple high-priority projects while delivering accurate, polished work under tight deadlines.
  • Operate with autonomy while keeping stakeholders informed, aligned, and engaged.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in employee, internal, or business communications.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clearly, concisely, and compellingly for diverse audiences.
  • Experience developing and executing strategic communications plans.
  • Experience leading change communications, including reorganizations, leadership transitions, program launches, and policy updates.
  • Proven ability to build collaborative relationships with senior leaders, including C-suite executives.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
  • Comfort working in a dynamic environment where priorities evolve and programs may still be under development.
  • Enthusiasm for using AI tools to enhance communications impact and automate workflows.
  • Familiarity with communications and collaboration tools such as Slack, Claude, Google Workspace, AI platforms, Confluence, and Zoom Events.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

  • Experience communicating with frontline, deskless, shift-based, or contingent workforces.
  • Background in technical communications related to software, artificial intelligence, information technology, or internal tools.
  • Experience partnering with executive and senior-level stakeholders.
  • Experience improving communications processes and workflows.
  • Advanced familiarity with Claude, Confluence, and Zoom Events.
  • Strong working knowledge of Slack and Google Workspace.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, marketing, business, or a related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in employee, internal, business, or strategic communications preferred.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, collaborative organization with complex stakeholder environments is strongly valued.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid.
  • Location: Foster City, California.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Contract duration: 12 months.
  • Start date: ASAP.
  • Two positions are available.

job.title: Clay Modeling Lead - Robot Industrial Design
job.description:
Clay Modeling Lead – Robot Industrial Design

Overview

Shape the future of autonomous mobility through exceptional craftsmanship, technical precision, and design leadership. The Clay Modeling Lead will guide the development and execution of full-size and scale clay models that transform industrial design vision into precise three-dimensional form.

Working at the intersection of design, engineering, digital modeling, and prototype development, you will lead clay model execution from early ideation through production feasibility. Your work will help define the physical expression of groundbreaking autonomous vehicles while ensuring that every surface reflects design intent and meets technical and manufacturing requirements.

Required Skills

  • 10+ years of hands-on automotive clay modeling experience within automotive design studios.
  • Proven experience leading clay model development from early concept through production.
  • Experience supporting both concept vehicles and production programs.
  • Extensive expertise creating and refining full-size and scale clay models.
  • Advanced proficiency in traditional hand modeling techniques and precision surfacing methods.
  • Expert understanding of:
  • Automotive proportions
  • Class-A surface development
  • Vehicle architecture
  • Production feasibility
  • Strong knowledge of clay modeling equipment and studio fabrication processes.
  • Experience with milling workflows and digital-to-physical model development.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Industrial Designers, Digital Modelers, Engineering, Prototype teams, and other cross-functional partners.
  • Strong organization, communication, and project management skills.
  • Ability to balance multiple concurrent programs, priorities, schedules, staffing needs, and studio resources.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and an unwavering commitment to craftsmanship, quality, and design excellence.
  • Ability to prepare presentation models and design bucks for leadership, executive, and cross-functional design reviews.
  • Knowledge of clay modeling processes, workflows, tooling, and fabrication techniques.
  • Ability to support studio equipment, materials, vendor relationships, budgeting, and resource planning.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience continuously improving clay modeling processes and workflows.
  • Experience introducing new technologies and methods that improve efficiency and model quality.
  • Experience supporting the integration of digital and physical model development.
  • Experience managing or coordinating studio operations in a fast-paced automotive design environment.
  • Experience working across multiple vehicle programs simultaneously.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 10+ years of professional automotive clay modeling experience in an automotive design studio.
  • Demonstrated leadership of clay model development across concept, refinement, and production-feasibility stages.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite.
  • Location: Foster City, CA.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Contract duration: 6 months.
  • Start: ASAP.

job.title: Senior Operations and Program Manager
job.description:
Senior Operations and Program Manager

Overview

Join a dynamic Executive Operations, Employee Communications, and Engagement team as a Senior Operations and Program Manager. In this high-impact role, you will serve as the operational right hand to the Director, helping drive planning, budgeting, reporting, team programs, and cross-functional initiatives forward.

You will partner closely with teams including People Experience, Finance, Creative Lab, and Legal to create structure across complex workstreams, improve operational rhythms, and ensure priorities remain on track. This position is ideal for an experienced operations or program leader who exercises sound judgment with confidential information, moves quickly, works independently, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Manufacturing Data Engineer
job.description:
Manufacturing Data Engineer

Overview

Build the data foundation powering manufacturing intelligence in this hands-on contract opportunity. As a Manufacturing Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain reliable data pipelines and models that bring together manufacturing data from on-premises databases, SAP MES, SAP HANA, test and diagnostic systems, and related sources. You will transform this data into trusted lakehouse tables that support manufacturing KPIs, dashboards, analytics, and AI use cases.

Approximately 80% of the role will focus on hands-on data engineering, with the remaining time dedicated to keeping pipelines deployable, observable, governed, and cost efficient. You will collaborate closely with data engineering, data analytics, manufacturing operations, infrastructure, and Databricks platform teams while supporting the migration of existing Redshift models and pipelines to Databricks.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years of professional data engineering experience
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, including PySpark
  • Hands-on production experience with Databricks, including:
  • Delta Lake
  • Unity Catalog permissions and governance
  • Databricks Workflows or jobs
  • Spark performance tuning
  • Production experience with dbt, including incremental models and testing
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Dimensional data modeling
  • Medallion architecture
  • Change data capture (CDC)
  • Incremental data loading
  • Experience building batch and streaming ingestion pipelines using technologies such as Auto Loader, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Connect, or Structured Streaming
  • Experience with incremental models, MERGE and upsert patterns, SCD Type 2, and late or out-of-order records
  • Experience deploying data code through Git-based workflows and CI/CD, such as GitHub Actions or Databricks Asset Bundles
  • Working knowledge of AWS data services, including S3, IAM, DMS, or Kinesis
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform
  • Ability to process large and semi-structured datasets, including JSON test payloads
  • Experience with data quality, pipeline monitoring, freshness SLAs, and alerting
  • Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to partner with technical teams, analysts, and manufacturing stakeholders

Nice to Have Skills

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional certification
  • AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect Associate
  • Experience preparing data for Databricks AI/BI dashboards, Genie, machine learning, or LLM use cases
  • Background working with manufacturing or industrial data, including quality, yield, traceability, station results, work orders, or MES
  • Experience migrating Redshift models and pipelines to Databricks
  • Familiarity with SAP MES, SAP HANA, AWS DMS, SAP SLT, Airflow, or Kinesis
  • Understanding of data governance and compliance as they relate to data pipelines
  • Experience managing Unity Catalog catalogs, schemas, volumes, grants, service principals, secret scopes, and OAuth machine-to-machine authentication
  • Experience monitoring cloud data platform usage, job health, and compute costs

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years of data engineering experience in production environments
  • Experience designing and supporting enterprise-scale data platforms, lakehouses, and analytics systems
  • Experience working with manufacturing, operational, or industrial data is preferred

Other Requirements

  • Contract duration: 12 months
  • Work arrangement: Fully onsite in Foster City, California
  • W2 engagement only
  • Ability to support production data pipelines, operational monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Ability to document pipelines, data lineage, data contracts, table definitions, runbooks, and operational procedures
  • Ability to collaborate across data engineering, analytics, manufacturing operations, infrastructure, and platform teams

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Senior Accountant — Remote Contract Opportunity

Overview

Join a globally recognized professional services organization as a Senior Accountant supporting critical global accounting operations. This role will focus on compensation-related accruals, month-end close activities, reconciliations, audit support, and process improvements across multiple regions. The ideal candidate is an experienced, independent accounting professional who can manage competing priorities, analyze financial data, and collaborate effectively with finance, payroll, HR, and other stakeholders.

This is a contract role with an estimated duration of four or more months and potential for contract-to-hire consideration.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • At least one year of relevant general accounting experience
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and standard accounting principles, methods, and applications
  • Experience supporting month-end close activities, including accruals, journal entries, reconciliations, and reporting
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to identify trends and variances between accruals and actual payments
  • Ability to work independently with limited oversight while proactively identifying risks, roadblocks, and necessary adjustments
  • Experience managing multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines
  • Ability to collaborate with stakeholders across multiple offices or regions and support standardized processes
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and integrity
  • Flexible, adaptable approach to changing processes, systems, and priorities

Nice to Have Skills

  • Exposure to compensation, benefits, bonus, severance, or payroll-related accounting
  • Experience working with global accounting operations or distributed teams
  • Experience partnering with payroll, HR, or local finance teams
  • Familiarity with SAP, Workday, ADP Workforce, or similar financial and human resources systems
  • Experience preparing audit schedules and documentation for independent auditors
  • Background documenting procedures, controls, and process improvement recommendations
  • Experience with financial reporting tools and large enterprise resource planning systems
  • Familiarity with the appropriate use of AI tools in accordance with organizational policies

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline is required
  • One or more years of relevant general accounting experience preferred
  • Experience with compensation, benefits, payroll, or global accounting is advantageous but not required
  • Candidates with a broader general accounting background are encouraged to apply

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and record monthly global compensation-related accruals, including bonus, severance, and other benefit programs
  • Ensure accurate and timely roll-down of accruals to entity-level books in accordance with US GAAP
  • Analyze accrual balances against actual payments and investigate trends, variances, and discrepancies
  • Recommend appropriate accounting adjustments and escalate significant accounting judgments or risks
  • Collaborate with payroll, HR, and finance stakeholders to ensure compensation-related data flows accurately through systems and into the general ledger
  • Support the month-end financial close process
  • Prepare monthly reporting packages and materials for senior leadership
  • Prepare detailed audit schedules and supporting documentation for year-end reviews
  • Draft and maintain clear documentation of procedures and controls
  • Identify and support ongoing process and technology improvements

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: 100% remote for the temporary contract, with candidates located in Eastern or Central Time considered
  • Contract-to-hire consideration: Candidates must be local to the Boston area and available to work onsite two days per week, Wednesday and Thursday
  • Ability to work a full-time schedule of approximately 40 hours per week
  • Successful completion of background screening, identity verification, education verification, and employment verification covering the previous five years before starting
  • Professional business-casual attire is required for onsite work; jeans are not permitted

job.title: Headrest Engineer
job.description:
Headrest Engineer

Overview

Lead the mechanical design and development of automotive headrest systems from concept through shipment. In this role, you will help advance complete seating systems by developing robust, manufacturable designs and supporting the in-house design and analysis process. You will collaborate closely with Industrial Design, Vehicle Engineering, Purchasing, Reliability, Packaging, Quality, Manufacturing, and Safety teams to resolve complex design challenges and deliver solutions that meet demanding safety, comfort, performance, and production requirements.

This role is well suited for an accomplished automotive seating engineer with deep expertise in headrest assemblies, seating structures, packaging, kinematics, and system-level development.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience leading automotive seating design and development projects.
  • Strong expertise designing seat components, particularly headrest assemblies.
  • Experience with seating structures and complete seat systems across multiple projects.
  • Ability to design headrest systems that address:
  • FMVSS safety requirements
  • Design considerations affecting HIC scores
  • IIHS requirements
  • Comfort requirements
  • Modal and NVH requirements
  • Operational strength requirements
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and general mechanical engineering analysis skills.
  • Strong materials knowledge, including an understanding of different materials and grades.
  • Ability to communicate design issues quantitatively through verbal presentations and technical documentation.
  • Significant 3D CAD experience, including proficiency with CATIA V6.
  • Experience with seat system packaging, kinematics, and modeling.
  • Demonstrated ability to design metallic and composite parts.
  • Working knowledge of finite element analysis theory and general mechanical engineering analysis.
  • Experience with:
  • Design for Manufacturability (DFM)
  • Design for Assembly (DFA)
  • Statistical tolerance analysis
  • Functional dimensioning
  • Geometric tolerancing
  • Preparing and checking 2D drawings
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and independently drive design issues to closure.
  • Flexibility and comfort working in a fast-paced environment subject to change.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience developing mechanical design and analysis capabilities in-house.
  • Broad experience spanning headrest assemblies, seating structures, and complete seat systems.
  • Experience creating and executing component or system test and validation plans.
  • Experience collaborating across design, engineering, manufacturing, quality, purchasing, reliability, packaging, and safety functions.
  • Experience documenting design trade-offs, technical decisions, and program status.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering required.
  • Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading automotive seating design and development programs is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite in Foster City, California.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Assignment duration: 18 months.
  • Start: ASAP.

job.title: Workday Integration Engineer
job.description:
Workday Integration Engineer — Remote Contract Opportunity

Overview

Join a People Engineering team focused on building transformative applications and experiences for employees and business groups. As a Workday Integration Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader across a broad ecosystem of Workday integrations, helping solve complex HR and Global Payroll challenges while improving the way people-related data moves across internal and external systems.

This role offers the opportunity to rethink existing architectures, strengthen Workday strategy, and deliver scalable integration solutions that support business growth. You will collaborate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and system owners to improve productivity, reliability, and data alignment across the organization.

Required Skills

  • 8+ years of experience working with Workday
  • Experience completing at least one full Workday implementation
  • Demonstrated expertise in Workday technical solutions and integrations
  • 6+ years of experience developing Workday integrations using:
  • Workday Studio
  • Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
  • Core Connectors
  • 6+ years of experience developing Workday custom reports and calculated fields
  • 6+ years of experience integrating Workday with third-party service vendors
  • Experience leading the research, design, development, testing, and delivery of Workday integrations
  • Ability to create detailed integration specifications, field mappings, and technical designs

job.title: AP Manager
job.description:
AP Manager — Fully Remote Interim Opportunity

Overview

Join a collaborative accounting organization as an Interim AP Manager and help maintain smooth, accurate accounts payable operations during a temporary leave-of-absence assignment. This hands-on role will oversee the full AP cycle, manage payment review and invoice approval workflows, partner closely with Procurement, and guide a team of two AP clerks. Reporting to the Chief Accounting Officer, you’ll play a key role in resolving issues, maintaining strong controls, and supporting a seamless month-end close.

  • Approval workflows
  • Payment runs and payment review
