job.title: Security Compliance Manager
job.description:
Security Compliance Manager

Overview

Lead the day-to-day execution of a growing technology company’s security compliance program and help enterprise customers move confidently through procurement. As the dedicated owner of security compliance operations, you will coordinate outsourced security partners, drive SOC 2 Type II activities, manage penetration testing and remediation, and respond to customer security reviews with speed and credibility.

This role is ideal for a seasoned security compliance professional who combines strong program management with customer-facing polish. You will partner closely with engineering, finance, leadership, and go-to-market teams while representing the organization in conversations involving security controls, data handling, AI governance, and responsible AI.

Required Skills

  • 4–7 years of experience in security compliance, GRC, or information security operations within a B2B SaaS or technology company
  • Experience coordinating a SOC 2 Type II program through at least two audit cycles, either in-house or with an outsourced provider
  • Proven ability to manage external vendors, establish deadlines, escalate issues, and drive accountability
  • Direct experience completing customer security questionnaires, RFPs, and vendor risk assessments at volume, including 30 or more annually
  • Confidence participating in customer procurement and security review calls and responding to detailed questions from security teams
  • Familiarity with compliance automation platforms such as Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, Worksheet, or similar tools
  • Working knowledge of cloud security concepts, including AWS or GCP, SSO and identity management, encryption, and access controls
  • Strong project management, organization, prioritization, and follow-through skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, leadership, external vendors, auditors, and go-to-market teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience working at an AI or machine learning company
  • Familiarity with AI security topics, including LLM data handling, prompt injection, model safety, and responsible AI
  • Exposure to AI compliance frameworks such as NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO/IEC 42001
  • Experience coordinating penetration tests, triaging findings, and tracking remediation with engineering teams
  • Experience supporting ISO 27001, HIPAA, or FedRAMP programs
  • Background in sales enablement or close partnership with go-to-market teams
  • Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes and security review workflows
  • Experience in a startup or growth-stage environment with minimal oversight

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Four to seven years of relevant experience in security compliance, GRC, or information security operations
  • Experience in a B2B SaaS, technology, AI, or machine learning environment is preferred
  • Experience coordinating at least two SOC 2 Type II audit cycles is preferred
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CompTIA Security+ are preferred
  • Specific educational requirements were not provided

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and project manager for an outsourced security agency
  • Set priorities, define deliverables, track milestones, and hold external partners accountable to service-level commitments
  • Coordinate with engineering and leadership to remove blockers and drive remediation work
  • Manage the compliance automation platform, ensuring evidence is current, controls are monitored, and gaps are identified early
  • Coordinate annual SOC 2 Type II audit activities, including readiness reviews, evidence collection, gap remediation, and audit execution
  • Maintain current security policies and control documentation in partnership with the outsourced agency and internal stakeholders
  • Track and report compliance status, open items, and remediation timelines to leadership
  • Manage the annual penetration testing cycle, including vendor scheduling, scope coordination, finding triage, remediation tracking, and validation
  • Own customer security questionnaires, RFPs, and vendor risk assessments while maintaining a reusable response library
  • Keep external security documentation and the company’s Trust Center up to date
  • Join customer procurement and security review calls with go-to-market teams
  • Represent the organization in AI governance, responsible AI, and AI compliance discussions
  • Monitor emerging AI compliance requirements and advise on their potential applicability
  • Maintain AI-related security and governance documentation, including data processing materials, AI use policies, and model governance summaries
  • Coordinate third-party vendor and subprocessors’ security assessments
  • Support security awareness training, incident response documentation, and periodic tabletop exercises
  • Provide regular security compliance updates to leadership

Other Requirements

  • Full-time contract position
  • Remote within the United States; Bay Area availability is a plus
  • Must be comfortable working with distributed teams and external service providers
  • Must be able to participate in customer-facing security, procurement, and AI governance discussions
  • Must be able to manage multiple compliance initiatives and deadlines with minimal oversight
  • Relevant security or compliance certification is preferred but not required

job.title: Professional Services Consultant
job.description:
Professional Services Consultant

Overview

Join a technical professional services team helping customers implement, onboard, and troubleshoot modern Zero Trust and security solutions. This remote consultant role is ideal for a hands-on security and networking professional who can translate complex technologies into successful production deployments, manage competing priorities, and guide customers through challenging technical environments.

You will work across identity, networking, endpoint management, web security, and cloud infrastructure while supporting projects from implementation through troubleshooting and optimization.

Required Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical implementation or onboarding team, security engineering team, security operations center, or another highly technical environment.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience focused on Zero Trust and/or SASE.
  • Strong command of the OSI model and core protocols, including:
  • TCP/IP
  • TLS, including TLS 1.3 and mTLS
  • DNS
  • HTTP/2
  • Deep understanding of Zero Trust technologies, including:
  • Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)
  • Secure Web Gateway (SWG)
  • Remote Browser Isolation (RBI)
  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
  • Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
  • Cloud Email Security
  • Strong knowledge of internet and security technologies, including:
  • Forward and reverse proxies
  • Content filtering and DLP
  • Sandboxing
  • Firewalls and next-generation firewalls (NGFWs)
  • Web application firewalls (WAF)
  • Bot management and rate limiting
  • SSL/IPsec and SSL/TLS VPN appliances and services
  • Hands-on experience configuring, deploying, migrating, or troubleshooting security technologies in production environments.
  • Experience integrating identity providers with enterprise applications, including:
  • SSO using SAML and OIDC
  • SCIM user and group provisioning and deprovisioning
  • Group and attribute mapping
  • Identity provider handshake troubleshooting
  • Working knowledge of modern identity technologies, including LDAP/Active Directory, MFA, FIDO2, and the role of the identity provider.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping.
  • In-depth DNS experience, including:
  • DNS filtering
  • DoH and DoT
  • Conditional forwarding and split-DNS
  • Internal-zone resolution
  • Local domain fallback
  • Experience with software distribution and deployment across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.
  • Windows and Linux server administration experience.
  • Client-endpoint troubleshooting across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
  • Ability to debug network connectivity issues using standard troubleshooting tools, including packet capture and DNS/HTTP tracing.
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to meet deadlines and prioritize competing demands.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese.
  • Automation and infrastructure-as-code experience with:
  • Terraform, preferably with the Cloudflare provider
  • REST APIs
  • Python or Bash scripting
  • Git
  • CI/CD
  • Policy-as-code
  • Cloud networking experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including:
  • VPC/VNet
  • Security Groups, NSGs, and NACLs
  • Cloud-native DNS resolvers
  • Cloud IAM
  • Connector deployment in IaaS environments
  • SASE on-ramp networking experience, including IPsec/GRE tunnels, BGP, Anycast, network segmentation, SD-WAN, MPLS, or WAN optimization.
  • MDM software distribution experience with Intune or Jamf.
  • Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, Entra ID, or Intune.
  • Observability experience, including Logpush, SIEM integrations, or Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX).
  • Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, or Chronicle.
  • Knowledge of NIST Zero Trust Architecture and compliance frameworks such as GDPR, DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, or FedRAMP.
  • Familiarity with AI security and shadow-AI governance, including AI-tool discovery, gating, and AI Gateway concepts.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in technical implementation, customer onboarding, security engineering, security operations, or a comparable technical field.
  • Demonstrated production experience configuring, deploying, migrating, and troubleshooting enterprise security, networking, identity, endpoint, or cloud technologies.
  • A specific educational background was not provided for this position; equivalent hands-on technical experience is relevant.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Time zone: Candidates must be able to work within Central Standard Time (CST).
  • Engagement type: W2 only.
  • Contract duration: 6 months.
  • Start date: As soon as possible.
  • English is required for day-to-day work. Spanish or Portuguese fluency is a strong advantage.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SC-300, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, CCNP, CCIE, CompTIA, or equivalent are strong advantages. Forensic certifications, including GCFA, GCFE, GCIA, or GCIH, are welcome but not central to the role.

job.title: Corp FP&A Mgr (COGS & Gross Margin)
job.description:
Corporate FP&A Manager, COGS & Gross Margin

Overview

A leading cloud-hosted B2B SaaS organization is seeking a hands-on Corporate FP&A Manager to own COGS planning, cloud infrastructure cost forecasting, gross margin analysis, and strategic finance initiatives. This high-impact role will provide critical visibility into cost-of-revenue drivers and help guide decisions that support efficient, scalable growth.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Cloud Operations, Support, Accounting, and executive leadership to translate complex AWS and operational data into clear financial insights. The ideal candidate can analyze cloud spend alongside technical teams, build driver-based financial models, identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, and confidently present gross margin performance to senior leaders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the COGS budget, forecast, monthly close support, and variance analysis.
  • Develop and maintain driver-based models for cloud infrastructure, Support operations, and cost-to-serve analysis.
  • Analyze AWS and cloud infrastructure spend and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Partner with Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Support leadership to understand cost drivers and identify efficiency opportunities.
  • Support gross margin planning, forecasting, reporting, and executive presentations.
  • Work with Accounting to ensure appropriate cost classification, accruals, and financial reporting accuracy.
  • Provide financial support for cloud cost optimization programs and infrastructure investment decisions.
  • Develop and present gross margin bridges, operational metrics, financial trends, and business recommendations.
  • Build business cases that inform infrastructure investments and Support staffing decisions.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 6–10 years of FP&A or strategic finance experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • At least 2–3 years of experience owning COGS and gross margin planning, forecasting, or analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience managing COGS plans, forecasts, and monthly flux across hosting, third-party software, Support headcount and vendors, and allocations.
  • Ability to build driver-based cost-to-serve models using metrics such as cost per TB, cost per customer, and cost per workload.
  • Experience developing Support capacity models, including tickets per engineer and cost per ticket.
  • Ability to read and analyze AWS Cost Explorer or Cost and Usage Report data.
  • Understanding of Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, storage tiers, and egress costs.
  • Strong GAAP knowledge and experience partnering closely with Accounting.
  • Ability to distinguish and classify production versus non-production cloud costs.
  • Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.
  • Experience with a financial planning platform such as Adaptive, Anaplan, Pigment, or a similar tool.
  • Experience working in NetSuite or a comparable ERP environment.
  • Proven ability to partner with Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Support leadership.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain gross margin and cost drivers clearly to technical and executive audiences.
  • Energetic, data-driven, curious, and comfortable working independently in a lean environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience in an organization with $100M–$1B in ARR.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed, pre-IPO, or public company environment.
  • Background in data protection, cybersecurity, storage infrastructure, or a related technology sector.
  • Experience supporting enterprise cloud commitments or EDP negotiations.
  • Experience partnering with Engineering teams on cloud cost optimization initiatives and savings program tracking.
  • Experience remapping a COGS chart of accounts or redesigning allocation methodologies.
  • SQL or business intelligence experience, including the ability to pull and analyze usage and billing data directly.
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner certification.
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams, including India-based Engineering organizations.
  • MBA and/or CPA.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 6–10 years of FP&A or strategic finance experience, with at least 3 years in B2B SaaS.
  • Demonstrated ownership of COGS, cloud infrastructure costs, gross margin, and cost-to-serve analysis.
  • Experience presenting financial results, gross margin bridges, and recommendations to CFO-level or executive audiences.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid role based in Santa Clara, with onsite work required Tuesday through Thursday.
  • Engagement: Initial 3-month contract with potential for contract-to-hire.
  • Must be comfortable collaborating with technical, operational, accounting, and executive stakeholders.
  • Must be able to work hands-on with AWS cost data and translate analysis into driver-based forecasts and business recommendations.

job.title: Senior NetSuite Analyst
job.description:
Senior NetSuite Analyst

Overview

Step into a high-impact role supporting a critical NetSuite environment at a time when continuity, technical expertise, and business partnership matter most. The Senior NetSuite Analyst will serve as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, helping prioritize, design, troubleshoot, and implement solutions across the Procurement and Order-to-Cash ecosystem.

This role is ideal for a hands-on NetSuite professional who combines strong technical capabilities with accounting knowledge and a consulting mindset. You will support an established NetSuite and Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) environment—not a new ERP implementation—while maintaining existing functionality, resolving complex issues, optimizing processes, and delivering enhancements and integrations. The position will collaborate closely with Finance, Accounting, Salesforce, and other business teams, serving as a project manager, business analyst, functional lead, and implementation resource for small- to medium-sized initiatives.

Required Skills

  • 4–6 years of relevant NetSuite experience, including hands-on experience with the Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) module.
  • NetSuite Certified Administrator certification or equivalent experience of 2–4 years.
  • Experience troubleshooting deferred revenue schedules and revenue recognition issues.
  • Experience supporting Order-to-Cash processes, including order processing, invoicing, tax calculations, and revenue recognition.
  • Experience working with NetSuite in an integrated Salesforce environment.
  • Hands-on NetSuite system configuration experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to create meaningful, accurate, and low-maintenance reports and saved searches.
  • Strong understanding of accounting and Finance and Accounting business processes.
  • Strong data analysis, problem-solving, and process-analysis skills.
  • Ability to diagram business processes and system workflows for different audiences.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into practical, scalable technology solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively within a team.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn and support a customized technology environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • A problem-solving mindset focused on building sustainable, long-term solutions while addressing immediate business needs.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce.com or a comparable CRM platform.
  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ, including product bundling and flexible pricing.
  • Experience with Avalara, Xactly, Concur, or AvidXchange.
  • Experience supporting invoice PDF generation and presentation solutions, including Conga.
  • Experience as a customer-facing consultant.
  • Experience acting as a project manager for small- to medium-sized technology projects.
  • Experience managing external consultants and implementation partners.
  • Ability to use SQL tools for research, requirements mapping, data analysis, and validation.
  • Experience supporting monthly and quarterly financial close processes.
  • Experience managing stakeholder backlogs, case queues, and system issue resolution.
  • Experience with NetSuite solution architecture and complex technical issue resolution.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Equivalent professional experience may be considered in place of a degree.
  • Senior-level experience administering, configuring, and optimizing NetSuite in an integrated business applications environment.
  • Experience supporting Finance and Accounting teams with operational systems, reporting, close processes, and audit readiness.
  • Experience gathering requirements, evaluating current-state processes, researching solution options, and managing implementation deliverables.

Other Requirements

  • Initial contract term of approximately three months, with potential to extend to six months or longer based on business and audit needs.
  • Contract-to-hire potential may be available; candidates who prefer to remain contractors are also welcome.
  • Full-time schedule of approximately 40 hours per week.
  • Hybrid position based in Waltham, MA, with onsite work required three days per week.
  • Up to 10% travel may be required.
  • Availability to begin as soon as possible is strongly preferred.
  • Must be comfortable supporting an established NetSuite environment, ongoing integrations, business-critical Finance and Accounting operations, and time-sensitive audit-related priorities.
  • Must be flexible, consultative, confident recommending best practices, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, constantly evolving environment.

job.title: Technical Revenue Accounting Manager
job.description:
Technical Revenue Accounting Manager

Overview

Lead critical revenue accounting, technical accounting, audit coordination, and financial reporting initiatives as an interim Technical Revenue Accounting Manager. This individual contributor role functions broadly as a revenue controller, with significant ownership of revenue recognition, COGS and inventory accounting, financial statement preparation, internal controls, international subsidiary reporting, and accounting systems transformation.

You will partner closely with the Controller and cross-functional teams to support accurate month-end close, resolve complex accounting matters, prepare audit materials, and help advance accounting processes during a period of organizational and systems change. The ideal candidate is an experienced technical accounting professional who can work independently, navigate ambiguity, and make sound judgments across complex transactions and evolving business needs.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong experience in technical accounting and revenue accounting
  • Expertise in revenue recognition, including related COGS, inventory, deferred revenue, and accounts receivable accounting
  • Required experience with NetSuite
  • Experience analyzing non-standard and complex contracts and determining appropriate accounting treatment
  • Ability to research and resolve revenue-related accounting issues
  • Experience overseeing revenue recognition analysis and reporting during the month-end close process
  • Ability to review revenue-related account reconciliations and key analyses across domestic and international operations
  • Experience investigating revenue fluctuations, identifying transactional drivers, and partnering with billing operations to resolve root causes
  • Experience collaborating with sales, finance, legal, FP&A, and other cross-functional teams
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, and finalizing financial statements
  • Experience supporting annual audits, including coordinating accurate, timely, and comprehensive audit requests
  • Strong understanding of internal controls, control risk matrices, and accounting documentation
  • Ability to draft, update, and organize technical accounting memoranda
  • Experience supporting international subsidiary reporting and accounting integration
  • Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently as a team of one and manage multiple priorities
  • Demonstrated ability to handle ambiguity and make sound decisions in an evolving environment

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience in an environmental commodities, energy trading, or similar trading-related business
  • Experience with long and short positions, commodity purchases and sales, and related revenue, COGS, and inventory accounting
  • Experience supporting the transition of international subsidiaries from pass-through entities to stand-alone trading entities
  • Experience participating in ERP integrations or accounting systems implementations
  • Experience providing accounting guidance during systems design, development, testing, and rollout
  • Experience developing or formalizing accounting policies and procedures
  • Experience working with energy trading and risk management or similar transaction and settlement systems
  • Experience supporting the design or implementation of automated registry, trading, or financial reporting systems

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred educational background was not specified.
  • Relevant experience in technical accounting, revenue accounting, financial reporting, audit coordination, and accounting systems is preferred.
  • Experience supporting complex, multi-entity accounting environments is beneficial.

Other Requirements

  • Interim contract engagement anticipated to last approximately 5–6 months, with potential for extension based on business needs.
  • Target start is ASAP, ideally before 11/20/2026, to support transition and continuity.
  • Fully remote candidates will be considered; availability to work onsite on Thursdays is preferred.
  • Candidates working remotely should be aligned with Pacific Time business hours; work within their local business hours is acceptable.
  • The role reports to the Controller and operates as an individual contributor.
  • The position will support audit and financial statement deadlines, including preparation and review of 2026 financial statements and coordination of audit deliverables.
  • No additional certifications were specified.

job.title: Senior Accounting Manager
job.description:
Senior Accounting Manager

Overview

Join a rapidly growing, globally operating manufacturing organization as a hands-on Senior Accounting Manager and trusted partner to the Controller. This individual-contributor role is ideal for an accounting professional who thrives in an evolving environment, brings strong manufacturing and global consolidation experience, and is ready to build structure, strengthen processes, and deliver accurate financial reporting across multiple entities.

You will own key accounting activities from journal entries and reconciliations through close, consolidation, audit support, and process improvement. Success in this role requires sound judgment, attention to detail, a willingness to investigate complex issues, and the confidence to ask questions and push back when needed.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of progressive accounting experience within the manufacturing industry.
  • Hands-on experience with general ledger accounting and month-end financial close.
  • Experience with global, multi-entity consolidations involving multiple currencies.
  • Knowledge of intercompany accounting, eliminations, foreign currency remeasurement and translation, and cumulative translation adjustments.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and the ability to apply accounting principles to operational transactions and financial reporting.
  • Practical understanding of manufacturing accounting, including:
  • Inventory valuation
  • Cost accounting concepts
  • Standard costs and manufacturing variances
  • Overhead allocation
  • Excess and obsolete inventory reserves
  • Work in process and finished goods
  • Inventory cutoff and goods received not invoiced
  • Experience with balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, fixed assets, construction in progress, leases, prepaids, and other core accounting areas.
  • Proficiency with NetSuite; the ability to prepare entries, extract financial data, reconcile subledgers, and develop reports or saved searches.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and analysis of large datasets.
  • Ability to independently research accounting issues, document conclusions, investigate discrepancies, and recommend resolutions.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing deadlines and deliver accurate, review-ready work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with international finance teams and cross-functional partners across time zones.
  • Willingness to work in an unstructured, fast-changing environment and take on varied responsibilities.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • NetSuite OneWorld experience.
  • Experience supporting acquisition integration and onboarding new legal entities.
  • Familiarity with Carta and Workday payroll systems.
  • Experience with purchase accounting, opening balance sheet reconciliations, chart of accounts mapping, and subsidiary reporting packages.
  • Experience supporting audits, SOX-readiness initiatives, control remediation, or internal-control improvements.
  • Experience developing accounting procedures, improving documentation, and scaling close and reporting processes.
  • Exposure to transfer-pricing-related entries, intercompany funding, and treasury activities.
  • Interest in learning and applying AI tools to improve accounting efficiency and reporting.

Preferred Education and Experience

The preferred candidate will hold a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline and bring 5–7 years of progressive accounting experience in manufacturing, including experience with global consolidations, multiple legal entities, intercompany accounting, inventory, cost accounting, and month-end close.

Experience working in a rapidly changing or acquisition-driven organization is highly beneficial. This role is designed for an experienced individual contributor who can operate independently while partnering closely with accounting leadership, operations, supply chain, tax, treasury, and international finance teams.

Other Requirements

  • This is a contract-to-hire, onsite role based in San Jose, California.
  • Candidates must be local to the Bay Area and able to commute to the San Jose office near the Great America/Santa Clara border.
  • The position requires at least four days per week in the office, Monday through Thursday, during the first 90 days to support onboarding and integration.
  • This is an individual-contributor position with no direct reports.
  • Candidates must be thorough, proactive, comfortable challenging assumptions, and willing to speak up when accounting issues or process risks require attention.

job.title: Senior Revenue Accountant
job.description:
Senior Revenue Accountant

Overview

Join a fast-paced Revenue Accounting team as a hands-on Senior Revenue Accountant supporting complex customer contracts, deal reviews, and critical month-end close activities. This contract role is ideal for an analytical accounting professional who is comfortable working in a constantly changing, unstructured environment and can independently drive projects from initial analysis through completion.

You will play a key role in evaluating revenue recognition considerations, supporting cross-functional deal discussions, maintaining audit-ready workbooks, and strengthening revenue accounting processes. The successful candidate will bring deep ASC 606 knowledge, strong technical accounting judgment, and the ability to communicate complex conclusions clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

  • Review complex and non-standard customer contracts and deals for revenue recognition implications.
  • Prepare contract summaries and technical accounting memos in accordance with ASC 606.
  • Identify performance obligations, determine standalone selling prices, and assess variable consideration.
  • Partner with Sales, Legal, and Deal Desk teams to advise on revenue recognition and compliant commercial terms.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate, audit-ready internal control workbooks.
  • Validate data accuracy and completeness using system reports and drive workbooks through completion.
  • Execute monthly revenue accounting activities in NetSuite, including journal entries and deferred revenue and accounts receivable reconciliations.
  • Support month-end close deliverables and revenue-related validations.
  • Assist with quarterly accounts receivable and revenue disclosures and financial reporting schedules.
  • Support collections forecasting, accounts receivable analysis, and Order-to-Cash activities.
  • Ensure supporting schedules tie accurately to the general ledger and are prepared for audit review.
  • Communicate project and close status clearly, proactively identify technical accounting issues, and recommend appropriate follow-up actions.
  • Contribute to projects that improve the broader revenue accounting process.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant revenue accounting experience.
  • Strong experience in software or SaaS environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with ASC 606.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing complex software contracts and preparing deal summaries.
  • Experience preparing audit-ready control workpapers and explaining the purpose and intent of related controls.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, data validation, and modeling large data sets.
  • Proficiency with NetSuite and Salesforce.
  • Experience with accounts receivable analysis, collections forecasting, and Order-to-Cash workflows.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex technical accounting concepts for non-finance stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, constantly changing, and unstructured environment.
  • Self-directed, hands-on approach with strong attention to detail.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • CPA license or active CPA candidacy.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional deal desk processes.
  • Experience with revenue-related disclosures and financial reporting schedules.
  • Experience contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within revenue accounting.
  • Experience with Odoo is not required.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of relevant revenue accounting experience, preferably within a software or SaaS organization.

Other Requirements

  • Ongoing contract position.
  • Fully onsite, five days per week, in Palo Alto, California.
  • Must be comfortable working in a rapidly evolving environment and managing responsibilities with limited structure.
  • Strong ownership, judgment, and follow-through are essential for success in this role.

job.title: Fixed Asset Accounting Manager/Sr. Manager
job.description:
Fixed Asset Accounting Manager/Sr. Manager

Overview

A growing organization is seeking a hands-on Fixed Asset Accounting Manager/Sr. Manager to lead critical fixed asset accounting activities and help resolve a significant backlog of reconciliations and rollforwards. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of the fixed asset function, strengthen audit readiness, and make an immediate impact in a fast-paced accounting environment.

Reporting to the Controller, the successful candidate will combine strong technical accounting expertise with people leadership, managing a team of three fixed asset accounting professionals. The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly in the details, prioritizing competing deadlines, and bringing structure and resolution to complex accounting matters.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and complete outstanding fixed asset reconciliations and rollforwards.
  • Reconcile Oracle Fixed Assets subledger balances to the general ledger and investigate variances.
  • Review fixed asset additions, disposals, transfers, depreciation, and other activity to explain changes in account balances.
  • Identify, document, and resolve discrepancies and open items.
  • Establish and maintain audit-ready supporting documentation and accounting records.
  • Review the work of fixed asset accounting team members and provide guidance, coaching, and feedback.
  • Manage three direct reports supporting fixed asset accounting.
  • Prioritize and work through a backlog while maintaining accuracy and meeting close deadlines.
  • Partner with the Controller and other accounting stakeholders to improve processes and strengthen controls.
  • Support audit requests and provide clear documentation for internal and external review.
  • Perform detailed accounting analysis and other fixed asset-related projects as needed.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Fixed Assets (OFA) is required.
  • Strong experience working in Oracle Fusion or a comparable Oracle environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to prepare fixed asset reconciliations and rollforwards.
  • Experience researching and resolving discrepancies between subledger and general ledger balances.
  • Strong understanding of fixed asset accounting, including additions, disposals, transfers, and depreciation.
  • Manager-level or higher experience in fixed asset accounting.
  • Experience managing, reviewing, or mentoring accounting staff.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal ramp-up and take ownership of the fixed asset function.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize a high-volume backlog.
  • Excellent analytical, documentation, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience supporting an audit or maintaining audit-ready accounting records.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting accounting operations following an acquisition or organizational transition.
  • Experience improving fixed asset accounting processes, controls, or documentation.
  • Exposure to Oracle Fixed Assets implementations or recent system go-live activities.
  • Experience in a fast-paced or evolving corporate accounting environment.
  • Ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and increased efficiency.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Manager-level or senior-manager-level fixed asset accounting experience is preferred.
  • Experience leading a team of accounting professionals is preferred.
  • Preferred educational requirements were not provided.

Other Requirements

  • Engagement: Contract position expected to last at least three months, with potential for extension and possible conversion to a permanent role.
  • Work arrangement: Hybrid preferred, with an expectation of being onsite Monday through Wednesday. Remote candidates may be considered.
  • Schedule: Remote candidates must be able to align with Pacific Time business hours.
  • Availability: Candidates should be prepared to begin as soon as possible.
  • Additional workload: Overtime and occasional weekend availability may be required during the initial month as the team works through the existing backlog.

job.title: Senior Cash Applications Specialist
job.description:
Senior Cash Applications Specialist

Overview

Join a collaborative Finance team as a Senior Cash Applications Specialist responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely application of client payments and supporting the integrity of financial records. This role will play an important part in billing, collections, reconciliations, and financial close activities while partnering with billing professionals, attorneys, clients, and internal stakeholders across multiple offices.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and confident taking ownership of complex cash application issues. This is an opportunity to serve as a subject matter resource, improve processes, and mentor junior team members in a dynamic professional services environment.

Required Skills

  • At least 3 years of experience owning cash application or accounts receivable processes; 5 years preferred
  • Experience supporting daily cash application activities as well as month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes
  • Ability to accurately apply incoming payments, including checks, wires, ACH payments, and credit cards
  • Experience researching and resolving unapplied or misapplied payments
  • Proficiency with billing software such as Elite 3E, Aderant, or a similar system
  • Experience with e-billing platforms
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office
  • Understanding of billing procedures, fee arrangements, and client-specific billing guidelines
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and time management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to interact effectively with legal staff, clients, management, and support personnel
  • Strong sense of accountability with a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and offices

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in a law firm or professional services environment
  • Familiarity with legal billing and client trust account transactions
  • Experience reconciling trust account activity in accordance with applicable policies and standards
  • Experience identifying and implementing process improvements
  • Previous experience mentoring or serving as a subject matter expert for junior team members
  • Experience working in a multi-office environment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Five or more years of cash application experience preferred
  • Experience with Elite 3E, Aderant, or comparable legal billing systems preferred
  • Legal industry experience preferred

Other Requirements

  • Hybrid schedule with two remote days and three in-office days per week
  • Position is based in either New York City or Boston
  • Standard schedule is Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with a one-hour lunch
  • Business-casual work environment
  • Successful completion of a background check and drug screen is required before starting
  • Occasional collaboration with colleagues across multiple offices is required

job.title: AP Specialist
job.description:
AP Specialist — Fully Remote Contract Opportunity

Overview

Join a small, collaborative Accounts Payable team supporting a fast-paced technology organization. As an AP Specialist, you’ll take ownership of high-volume, full-cycle accounts payable activities while helping ensure invoices are processed accurately, approvals move efficiently, and vendor accounts remain reconciled. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented accounting professional who can work independently, communicate clearly in a virtual environment, and quickly adapt to new systems and processes.

Required Skills

  • Strong full-cycle accounts payable experience
  • High-volume invoice processing experience, including approximately 800+ invoices per month
  • Experience entering invoices, requesting approvals, and resolving discrepancies
  • Hands-on experience with 2-way and 3-way matching in NetSuite
  • Experience performing vendor statement reconciliations
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUPs and PivotTables
  • Experience with expense processing in Concur
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to learn systems, processes, and data-entry requirements quickly with minimal ramp-up
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to document processes and communicate effectively through virtual meetings and training
  • Strong workload management and self-management skills
  • Flexibility to pivot, take initiative, and support the team where needed

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience working on a small Accounts Payable team
  • Previous experience in a fully remote accounting role
  • Experience taking ownership of assigned vendor relationships
  • Experience supporting process improvements or documenting AP procedures
  • Experience in a fast-paced technology or corporate environment

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Several years of progressive, full-cycle accounts payable experience preferred
  • Experience with NetSuite and Concur preferred
  • Formal educational requirements were not specified for this opportunity

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, approximately 6–8 hours per day, with the schedule arranged between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Duration: Anticipated 2–6+ months, with the possibility of extension
  • Start: ASAP
  • Must be comfortable working independently in a remote environment and participating in virtual meetings and training
  • Must be able to manage a high-volume workload while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines

job.title: Project Manager - Real Estate Project Design & Delivery
job.description:
Project Manager – Real Estate Project Design & Delivery

Location: Hybrid — San Francisco, CA
Duration: 6 months
Employment Type: W2 only
Start Date: ASAP

Overview

Lead the delivery of multiple workplace capital construction projects as the essential link between business stakeholders, internal partner teams, and the external professionals responsible for design and construction. This role offers the opportunity to shape projects from early planning through handover, applying technical judgment, strategic thinking, and strong project leadership to ensure workplace environments are delivered on time, within budget, and ready for business operations.

As an owner-side project representative and integrator, you will translate business and operational needs into clear project briefs, coordinate complex third-party teams, establish effective project controls, and provide concise recommendations to executive and non-technical audiences. Success in this role requires the ability to anticipate downstream impacts, identify risks early, and balance detailed execution with broader project objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Represent internal business users and partner functions throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Partner with Workplace Services, Security, IT, AV, Finance, Procurement, and Legal to incorporate requirements, approvals, budgets, and schedules into project plans.
  • Translate business and operational needs into functional program briefs and scopes of work.
  • Coordinate construction project managers, architects, MEP engineers, code consultants, general contractors, and other third-party professionals.
  • Establish ownership of deliverables, communication processes, and escalation pathways.
  • Maintain project controls for scope, schedule, budget, procurement, compliance, risk, and change management.
  • Coordinate stakeholder design and functional program reviews.
  • Document approvals and decisions affecting procurement and construction milestones.
  • Monitor progress against approved project plans and schedules.
  • Identify emerging risks, assess root causes, and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Represent project status and decision points at governance meetings.
  • Prepare concise executive summaries covering project progress, significance, risks, impacts, and required actions.
  • Coordinate project handover and first day of business readiness.
  • Confirm completion of as-built documentation, training, warranty, and maintenance information.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in project or program management, construction, architecture, engineering, corporate real estate, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering complex workplace or capital projects.
  • Working knowledge of commercial office construction processes, including:
  • Design coordination
  • Construction documentation
  • Permitting
  • Scheduling
  • Budgeting
  • Procurement
  • Change management
  • Commissioning
  • Project handover
  • Experience translating diverse stakeholder needs into clear requirements, decisions, and execution plans.
  • Ability to navigate competing priorities while maintaining focus on project objectives.
  • Familiarity with project controls and financial management, including budget development, cash-flow forecasting, change control, risk management, and approval tracking.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical project information clearly and concisely to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong strategic judgment and the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to balance attention to detail with broader project goals and adapt as project needs evolve.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

  • Experience delivering corporate workplace projects within a technology or other high-growth, matrixed organization.
  • Experience integrating technical workplace requirements, including IT, AV, security, building systems, or other specialist scopes, into construction delivery.
  • Experience representing an occupier or owner.
  • Experience managing external consultants, project managers, landlords, vendors, or general contractors.
  • Project management, construction management, or sustainability credentials such as PMP, CCM, or LEED.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in design, construction management, architecture, engineering, real estate, or a related field.
  • Equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience supporting the delivery of complex workplace or capital projects.

Other Requirements

  • This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA.
  • Candidates must be able to work on a W2 basis.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with internal stakeholders and third-party project teams throughout design, construction, commissioning, and handover.

job.title: Assistant Project Manager - Real Estate Project Design & Delivery
job.description:
Assistant Project Manager – Real Estate Project Design & Delivery

Overview

Support the delivery of multiple workplace construction projects in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. As an Assistant Project Manager, you’ll partner with Project Managers, third-party project teams, and internal Real Estate, Workplace, Finance, and Procurement stakeholders to keep project design, construction, budget, schedule, procurement, and approval information complete and current.

This role is ideal for a highly organized project professional who brings strong process discipline, sound judgment, and the ability to identify issues before they affect project commitments, payments, or delivery milestones. You’ll contribute to projects from design coordination through construction, handover, and first-day business readiness while helping strengthen project delivery processes and reporting standards across global projects.

Required Skills

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in project management, program management, project coordination, project controls, construction, architecture, engineering, corporate real estate, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting the delivery of complex workplace or capital projects.
  • Familiarity with commercial office construction processes, including:
  • Design coordination
  • Construction documentation
  • Permitting
  • Scheduling
  • Budgeting
  • Procurement
  • Project handover
  • Knowledge of project controls and financial processes, including budget development, cash-flow forecasting, change control, risk management, and approval tracking.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to distinguish routine project updates from issues requiring timely escalation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to present project data concisely to internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Project Managers, third-party project teams, Finance, Procurement, and other internal partners.
  • Ability to track and maintain accurate information related to scopes of work, contract approvals, purchase orders, change requests, budgets, schedules, and procurement milestones.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience delivering corporate workplace projects in a technology or other high-growth, matrixed organization.
  • Experience representing an occupier or owner.
  • Experience managing external consultants, project managers, landlords, vendors, or general contractors.
  • Familiarity with workplace design guidelines and technical IT/AV and Security standards.
  • Experience improving project reporting templates, trackers, and delivery processes across multiple projects.
  • Experience supporting FF&E, minor works, signage, punch lists, and first-day business readiness activities.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in design, construction management, architecture, engineering, real estate, or a related field.
  • Equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • 3–5 years of experience in project management, project coordination, project controls, construction, architecture, engineering, corporate real estate, or a related discipline.

Other Requirements

  • This is a hybrid position based in San Francisco, California.
  • W2 employment only.
  • Ability to support multiple projects and coordinate with internal and external project teams.
  • Ability to track approval progress and flag incomplete documentation, stalled approvals, and process exceptions before they delay commitments or payments.
  • Ability to support project handover and first-day business readiness preparations with project teams and internal partners.

job.title: Production Designer

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented creative thinker who thrives at the intersection of design and organization. You’ll transform concepts into polished, production-ready assets, develop scalable design resources, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring a new brand to life in innovative ways.

Required Skills

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating:
