job.title: Treasury Contractor
job.description:
Treasury Contractor

Overview

Join a high-growth SaaS organization as a hands-on Treasury Contractor supporting global treasury operations across more than 15 countries. This interim role will help establish and strengthen the company’s internal treasury function, with immediate ownership of cash forecasting, liquidity management, bank account administration, and debt covenant compliance.

Reporting to the VP of Corporate Controllership, you will work directly in Excel and banking systems to maintain accurate forecasts, monitor cash positions, and prepare treasury reporting. This is an opportunity for an experienced treasury professional to build scalable processes, improve global cash management, strengthen banking relationships, and help shape treasury operations across multiple currencies and jurisdictions.

Required Skills

  • 7–10 years of progressive treasury experience, preferably within the technology, SaaS, or financial services industry
  • Hands-on experience with global cash management, liquidity forecasting, and multi-currency operations
  • Experience managing banking relationships across multiple entities and jurisdictions
  • Strong financial modeling and advanced Excel skills
  • Experience with bank account administration and treasury reporting
  • Working knowledge of foreign exchange risk management and hedging instruments
  • Familiarity with debt covenant compliance and related reporting
  • Understanding of SOX controls within treasury operations
  • Experience working with treasury management systems and banking platforms
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Accounting, FP&A, Payroll, Legal, auditors, banking partners, and executive leadership
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively across time zones
  • Ability to operate independently as a hands-on individual contributor in a developing function
  • SaaS or high-growth startup experience is required

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience building or significantly expanding a treasury function at a high-growth company
  • Experience with ASC 815 hedge accounting
  • Exposure to emerging-market treasury operations and ARS-related activity
  • Experience with cash pooling, intercompany funding, and working capital management
  • Experience supporting IPO readiness or public company audits
  • Experience with short-term investment strategy and liquidity planning
  • Experience supporting capitalization events, tender offers, or equity-related transactions
  • Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) designation
  • CPA or equivalent professional certification

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field preferred
  • 7–10 years of progressive treasury experience
  • Background in a global, multi-entity, multi-currency environment
  • Experience establishing treasury processes, controls, reporting, and infrastructure from the ground up

Key Responsibilities

Cash Management and Liquidity

  • Build and manage global cash management infrastructure across multiple operating entities and banking partners
  • Develop daily, weekly, and monthly cash flow forecasts
  • Deliver liquidity analysis and reporting to senior finance leadership
  • Establish cash pooling, intercompany funding, and working capital management processes
  • Support short-term investment strategy in coordination with external advisors
  • Monitor global cash balances and identify liquidity needs and opportunities

Banking and Financial Institution Relationships

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for global banking relationships
  • Evaluate and optimize the banking structure as the organization expands
  • Support bank account openings across new jurisdictions
  • Manage banking services and relationships in partnership with internal stakeholders
  • Partner with Payroll and Accounts Payable to support timely funding for international payroll and vendor payments

Cross-Functional Partnership and Compliance

  • Partner with Payroll on compliant funding across multiple international locations
  • Collaborate with Legal and Accounting on capitalization events, tender offers, and equity-related transactions
  • Support treasury disclosures, audit requests, and covenant reporting
  • Provide FP&A with cash flow forecasting inputs and capital allocation analysis
  • Develop and maintain treasury policies, procedures, controls, and reporting practices
  • Help establish foreign exchange risk management and liquidity reporting processes

Other Requirements

  • Fully remote work is permitted; candidates in the Bay Area are preferred
  • This is a hands-on individual contributor position and is not a people-management role
  • Initial contract duration is expected to be 3–4 months, with potential for extension and possible conversion to a permanent position
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones and international entities
  • Must be comfortable working directly in Excel, banking systems, and other treasury-related platforms
  • Must be able to manage confidential financial information with discretion and accuracy

job.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Milestone Execution
job.description:
Senior Technical Program Manager – Milestone Execution

Overview

Lead complex, cross-functional product and service milestones that advance the development and launch of innovative mobility solutions. As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will partner with leaders across vehicle development, systems engineering, software, manufacturing, fleet operations, and business functions to drive milestone execution from strategy through delivery.

You will translate technical and organizational complexity into clear actions, measurable outcomes, timely decisions, and effective execution. This role is ideal for a collaborative program leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, can influence stakeholders across disciplines, and brings strong judgment to product launches, validation, testing, and operational readiness.

Required Skills

  • Lead execution of major product or service milestones, including milestone test strategy and feature lock activities.
  • Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and milestone success metrics that align progress with business goals.
  • Drive stakeholder alignment and executive buy-in on success metrics and program decisions.
  • Provide concise, effective communications regarding program status, accomplishments, risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Present information to functional engineering management, engineering leadership, and executive leadership.
  • Collaborate with software, hardware, systems engineering, manufacturing, and operations teams to resolve issues and remove release blockers.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of one or more of the following:
  • Vehicle platforms
  • Software development lifecycles
  • Safety clearance processes
  • Test operations
  • Manage complex, cross-functional programs involving multiple technical and operational teams.
  • Apply project management tools and processes, including Gantt charts, risk matrices, Smartsheet, JIRA, or comparable solutions.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving, negotiation, influencing, and escalation-management abilities.
  • Communicate complex technical and program information clearly and concisely at the senior executive level.
  • Hold a BS or MS degree in an engineering discipline, or possess equivalent engineering experience in lieu of an engineering degree.
  • Have at least 8 years of experience in engineering or program management, with a focus on product launches, validation, and/or testing.
  • Have a proven track record managing complex cross-functional projects.
  • Bring experience with automotive or aerospace processes, test platforms, simulation, autonomous vehicles, or verification and validation disciplines.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.
  • Experience with autonomous vehicles, test platforms, simulation, or automotive or aerospace processes.
  • Experience developing and scaling program strategies, processes, plans, procedures, and reporting.
  • Experience managing escalations and coordinating resolution of high-priority, cross-functional issues.
  • Experience working in a program management office supporting complex organizational decisions and major corporate milestones.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering preferred; equivalent engineering experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Eight or more years of experience in engineering or technical program management.
  • Professional experience focused on product launches, validation, testing, milestone execution, or related technical program delivery.
  • Demonstrated success coordinating initiatives across engineering, software, hardware, systems, manufacturing, and operations teams.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite.
  • Location: Foster City, CA.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Assignment duration: Approximately 6 months.
  • Start: ASAP.

job.title: Engineer - Robot Platform Test Automation
job.description:
Engineer – Robot Platform Test Automation

Overview

Help advance the next generation of autonomous mobility as a Robot Platform Test Automation Engineer. In this onsite role, you’ll automate design validation and characterization testing for robotaxi hardware and systems, working at the intersection of software, electronics, firmware, mechanical engineering, and systems engineering.

You’ll build reusable libraries, tools, hardware interfaces, and scripts that support functional and characterization testing with hardware-in-the-loop. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on test quality, engineering efficiency, and long-term software maintainability while helping establish and enforce best practices across the development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Implement design characterization tests for robotaxi hardware and systems.
  • Develop reusable libraries for interfacing with laboratory equipment and displaying live test data.
  • Create reusable tools for semi-automated testing and test station configuration.
  • Collaborate with test leads to design test stations and plans based on technical specifications.
  • Partner with Mechanical, Electrical, Firmware, and Systems engineers on test development and execution.
  • Collaborate with design engineers and project managers to plan and support test campaigns.
  • Develop software and automation that supports hardware-in-the-loop testing.
  • Document software and tools so they are accessible and maintainable for users inside and outside the team.
  • Promote code quality, long-term maintainability, and software engineering best practices.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of programming experience in Python, or an equivalent level of skill.
  • 5+ years of experience with electronics or hardware testing, or an equivalent level of skill.
  • Experience with concurrent programming using threads and queues.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks such as PyTest or Robot Framework.
  • Experience developing Bash scripts or embedded C/C++ in a Linux environment.
  • Strong software development fundamentals with a focus on code quality and maintainability.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Strong technical documentation and problem-solving skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Working knowledge of standard object-oriented software design patterns.
  • Experience with communications protocols such as CAN, Ethernet, or TCP/IP.
  • Experience with Git, Jira, Reviewable, Bamboo, Polarion, or TestRail.
  • Experience using static analysis tools and code formatters such as Ruff, PyLint, MyPy, or Black.
  • Experience developing test stations, laboratory automation, or hardware-in-the-loop systems.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional programming experience, preferably with significant Python development.
  • 5+ years of electronics, embedded systems, laboratory, or hardware testing experience.
  • Experience working on complex hardware and software systems in a collaborative engineering environment.

Other Requirements

  • This is an onsite position in Foster City, California.
  • The assignment is expected to run for approximately 12 months.
  • Availability to start as soon as possible is preferred.
  • W2 employment only.

job.title: Operations Analyst
job.description:
Operations Analyst

Overview

Join a Fleet Operations Strategic Operations team as an Operations Analyst supporting data-driven decisions across a complex, fast-paced organization. In this role, you’ll partner with functional leaders to evaluate performance, identify operational gaps, investigate root causes, and translate imperfect data into clear, actionable recommendations.

You’ll help strengthen the operating mechanisms that guide Fleet Operations, including KPI development, recurring business reviews, performance reporting, and improvement initiatives. This is an opportunity for an analytical, detail-oriented professional who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and connecting operational drivers to meaningful business outcomes.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, engineering, operations, analytics, or a related quantitative field
  • At least 2 years of experience in operations analytics, business operations, strategy and operations, consulting, finance, or a related role
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems
  • Proficiency with SQL, AI tooling, and spreadsheets
  • Experience using data visualization or business intelligence tools
  • Ability to work with large, imperfect, or fragmented datasets and determine reasonable conclusions
  • Experience analyzing operational efficiency, including staffing, utilization, throughput, cycle time, capacity, or cost
  • Ability to identify trends, bottlenecks, root causes, and opportunities for improvement
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to synthesize complex analysis into concise, decision-oriented insights
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across technical and operational teams
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience working in a high-growth or operationally complex environment
  • Experience analyzing frontline or field operations
  • Background in workforce planning, capacity planning, process improvement, or operational efficiency
  • Familiarity with Python or other analytical tools
  • Experience partnering with Data Science, Engineering, Product, or Finance teams
  • Experience supporting executive or senior-leadership operating reviews
  • Experience developing business cases and quantifying the expected impact of operational improvements
  • Familiarity with KPI development, metric documentation, data quality, and performance reporting

Preferred Education and Experience

A bachelor’s degree in business, economics, engineering, operations, analytics, or another quantitative discipline is preferred. Candidates should have 2 or more years of relevant experience in operations analytics, business operations, strategy and operations, consulting, finance, or a related field.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze Fleet Operations performance across readiness, fleet response, ground operations, infrastructure, training, and market operations
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to uncover performance trends, bottlenecks, root causes, and improvement opportunities
  • Connect operational drivers to topline outcomes and develop actionable recommendations
  • Build business cases and quantify the potential impact of operational improvements
  • Support the development and operationalization of Fleet Operations KPIs across multiple levels
  • Partner with functional teams to improve metric definitions, data quality, targets, and reporting
  • Maintain metric documentation and promote consistency across dashboards and business reviews
  • Identify gaps in existing measurement and recommend additional analyses
  • Prepare performance analyses for weekly business reviews and other recurring operating reviews
  • Surface significant performance changes and areas requiring leadership attention
  • Track actions and follow-ups from operating reviews and measure subsequent impact
  • Improve recurring reporting and review processes as the organization scales
  • Conduct cross-industry research on operating models, benchmarks, and best practices
  • Support special projects involving organizational performance, operating model improvements, automation, and cost efficiency
  • Synthesize findings into clear recommendations and decision-support materials

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid
  • Location: Foster City, CA
  • Engagement: W2 only
  • Contract duration: 6 months
  • Anticipated start: ASAP

job.title: Analyst Relations Specialist
job.description:
Analyst Relations Specialist

Overview

Support the operational engine behind a global Analyst Relations program as an Analyst Relations Specialist. This remote role is ideal for a highly organized, detail-oriented professional who enjoys coordinating complex initiatives, partnering with multiple stakeholders, and creating scalable processes that improve collaboration and efficiency.

Working closely with Analyst Relations, Product Marketing, and cross-functional teams, you will help manage analyst engagements, evaluative research programs, industry intelligence, content operations, and program reporting. Your work will help ensure analyst interactions are thoughtfully prepared, deadlines are met, information is accessible, and key insights are effectively shared across the organization.

Required Skills

  • Experience coordinating projects, programs, or operations across multiple stakeholders.
  • One to three years of experience in Analyst Relations, Public Relations, Product Marketing Operations, B2B Technology Communications, Project Coordination, or Program Coordination.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience using collaboration and productivity tools such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Slack.
  • Experience with project management tools and operational tracking.
  • Ability to create repeatable processes, templates, workflows, and documentation.
  • Proactive problem-solving approach with a focus on operational excellence.
  • Ability to coordinate contributors, manage versions, track milestones, and maintain accurate records.
  • Strong follow-through and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Exposure to enterprise technology Analyst Relations programs.
  • Experience supporting Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape, or similar evaluative research processes.
  • Familiarity with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, or other industry analyst firms.
  • Experience working within an enterprise software or B2B technology organization.
  • Experience supporting long-term, cross-functional programs and initiatives.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools and workflow automation.
  • Experience with analyst portals, content repositories, reporting dashboards, or sentiment analysis.

Key Responsibilities

Analyst Engagement Management

  • Manage the operational lifecycle of analyst interactions, including intake, scheduling, logistics, tracking, and reporting.
  • Prepare briefing materials, speaker biographies, historical interaction summaries, and supporting documentation.
  • Support industry events through planning, coordination, onsite assistance when required, and post-event reporting.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure analyst engagements are organized, accurate, and completed on schedule.

Evaluative Research and Content Operations

  • Support participation in Gartner Magic Quadrants, Forrester Waves, IDC MarketScapes, and similar analyst research programs.
  • Track research milestones, coordinate contributors, manage document versions, and oversee submission deadlines.
  • Maintain a centralized repository of approved RFI responses, customer references, product information, benchmark results, and supporting content.
  • Manage analyst portal content, user access, editorial calendars, and ongoing content maintenance.
  • Provide operational support for research submissions and analyst requests.

Program Tracking and Intelligence Sharing

  • Monitor analyst research publications, commentary, blogs, and market coverage trends.
  • Maintain program metrics, activity tracking, reporting dashboards, and sentiment analysis.
  • Develop and distribute post-briefing summaries, analyst insights, and research highlights to stakeholders and executive audiences.
  • Support strategic planning by ensuring analyst intelligence is accurate, accessible, and well organized.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, collaboration, and operational efficiency across the program.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • One to three years of relevant professional experience in Analyst Relations, Public Relations, Product Marketing Operations, B2B Technology Communications, project coordination, or program coordination.
  • Experience working with enterprise technology organizations or cross-functional teams is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote.
  • Engagement: Approximately one year.
  • Start: ASAP.
  • Employment type: W-2 only.
  • Availability to support occasional industry events and related onsite assistance when required.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across multiple teams and manage time-sensitive deliverables.

job.title: Restraints Engineer - Trim and Lighting
job.description:
Restraints Engineer – Trim and Lighting

Overview

Join a Vehicle Engineering team developing next-generation autonomous vehicles. As a Restraints Engineer, you will own restraint system development from requirements definition and supplier sourcing through testing, validation, and production release. You will apply deep occupant protection expertise to define technical specifications, guide component and system design, resolve complex fleet and production issues, and drive restraint systems toward performance, quality, manufacturability, serviceability, and program readiness.

This role offers the opportunity to collaborate closely with safety, vehicle integration, quality, supply chain, manufacturing, service, procurement, engineering, suppliers, and program management teams in a highly cross-functional environment.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and own restraint system requirements and System/Subsystem Technical Specifications (SSTS), cascading requirements to components and suppliers.
  • Develop restraint components from concept through production release while meeting homologation, certification, and program requirements.
  • Lead RFQ activities for restraint components, including preparation of technical packages, evaluation of supplier responses, and support for sourcing decisions.
  • Support the resolution of open restraint issues, including critical design and build issues affecting performance, quality, and production readiness.
  • Perform structured root-cause analysis using methodologies such as 8D and Fishbone.
  • Plan, execute, and sign off on restraint testing at both the component and system levels as part of the overall occupant protection system.
  • Apply CAE tools to guide restraint system design and validate performance.
  • Influence system designs through design reviews, DFMEAs, validation activities, and manufacturing mock-builds.
  • Partner with suppliers, quality, procurement, service, manufacturing, and engineering teams to drive complex issues to closure and support on-time delivery.
  • Use 3DX to investigate packaging and part relationship issues.
  • Manage engineering changes and technical documentation using JIRA, Confluence, Polarion, and PLM tools.
  • Identify and communicate program progress, engineering challenges, and technical risks to Technical Program Management.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 4 years of design and release experience with restraint components.
  • Experience writing and managing system and component requirements, including technical specifications such as SSTS.
  • Experience supporting RFQs and supplier selection for automotive safety components.
  • Experience testing and signing off on restraint components at both the component level and system level.
  • Working knowledge of restraint regulatory, homologation, and certification requirements, including FMVSS and NCAP.
  • Experience applying CAE tools in the development of restraint systems.
  • Strong understanding of DFMEA and PFMEA for passive safety components.
  • Proficiency with structured root-cause analysis methods, including 8D and Fishbone.
  • Proficiency with engineering and project tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Polarion, Gantt charts, ERP, PLM, and ALM.
  • Experience using 3DX to investigate packaging and part relationship issues.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to engage assertively and effectively across complex, multi-supplier relationships.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support builds, supplier visits, and testing.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Passion for electric vehicles, autonomous mobility, and next-generation vehicle development.
  • Current knowledge of developments in restraint systems and emerging occupant protection technologies.
  • Experience using Claude or other AI tools to accelerate engineering work, such as data analysis and documentation.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 4+ years of experience designing and releasing automotive restraint components.
  • Experience carrying restraint systems through requirements definition, supplier sourcing, development, testing, validation, and production release.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite.
  • Location: Foster City, California.
  • Engagement: Six-month contract.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Start timing: ASAP.
  • Travel may be required for builds, supplier visits, and testing.

job.title: Senior Contracts Specialist
job.description:
Senior Contracts Specialist

Overview

Bring your expertise in IT contracting to a high-impact role supporting complex technology engagements and enterprise-wide contract excellence. The Senior Contracts Specialist will draft, review, negotiate, and manage Statements of Work (SOWs), amendments, and IT Professional and Consulting Services agreements across Managed Services, Fixed Fee, and Staff Augmentation engagements.

Working collaboratively with IT business units, service delivery teams, Legal, Procurement, preferred providers, and other stakeholders, you will ensure contracts accurately reflect business requirements, mitigate risk, support value delivery, and move efficiently from initial request through execution and Purchase Order issuance when required. This role is ideal for a highly organized contracts professional who can independently manage multiple priorities while building trust across all levels of an organization.

Required Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in IT corporate contracts
  • 4–6 years of hands-on experience drafting, negotiating, and executing IT Professional Services contracts
  • Proven experience independently drafting, negotiating, and managing:
  • Time and Materials (T&M) agreements
  • Fixed Fee agreements
  • Managed Services agreements
  • Statements of Work and amendments
  • Extensive experience negotiating complex agreements that incorporate risk mitigation measures, including Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), service levels, and governance procedures
  • Strong understanding of legal terminology and contract principles
  • Excellent written communication and clear, concise contract-drafting skills
  • Strong oral communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills
  • Ability to review redlines, identify business and legal issues, and escalate appropriately
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder meetings to define and document business requirements, specifications, and specialized terms
  • Experience working directly with attorneys, Legal, Procurement, vendors, and other third parties in advisory and negotiation capacities
  • Ability to validate resource plans against rate cards, including roles, rates, and locations
  • Experience developing service levels and incorporating them into agreements and vendor governance processes
  • Sound business judgment and the ability to make reasonable, well-informed decisions
  • Ability to understand internal clients’ business objectives and independently resolve challenges
  • Ability to conduct legal and other research and apply relevant best practices
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Word, including redlining, tracked changes, and contract formatting
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple contracts and projects under tight deadlines
  • Excellent time management, prioritization, responsiveness, and customer-service skills
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment
  • Bachelor’s degree, law degree, or paralegal experience

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with ServiceNow
  • Experience with Jira
  • Experience working in an Agile or Kanban environment
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel
  • Experience supporting engagements exceeding $100 million in value
  • Experience developing or updating Standard Operating Procedures, contract forms, process documentation, or training materials
  • Experience providing training to service delivery or business teams on contracting processes
  • Experience with Vendor Management Exception processes
  • Experience supporting continuous improvement initiatives within contract management
  • Experience working within shared file management and document-control structures

Preferred Education and Experience

job.title: Junior Engineer - QA Engineering & Tooling
job.description:
Junior Engineer – QA Engineering & Tooling

Overview

Join a fast-moving engineering team building the tools and systems that support quality assurance for advanced robotic mobility applications. As a Junior Engineer, you’ll contribute to full-stack applications, testing frameworks, pipeline automation, and emerging AI-assisted workflows that help engineering teams test, review, and triage more effectively.

This role is designed for an early-career software engineer who is eager to build production software, work across frontend and backend systems, and learn from experienced engineers. You’ll take ownership of well-scoped projects while collaborating with cross-functional partners to solve practical QA engineering challenges.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree completed, in progress, or recently completed in computer science, engineering, or a related field
  • 0–2 years of professional or internship experience in software engineering
  • Working proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Familiarity with React or a similar frontend framework
  • Understanding of REST APIs and Git/version control
  • Ability to work independently on well-scoped assignments
  • Willingness to ask clarifying questions when requirements are ambiguous
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Eagerness to learn from senior engineers and contribute in a collaborative environment
  • Ability to write and maintain unit and integration tests, troubleshoot defects, and improve software reliability

Nice to Have Skills

  • Exposure to LLM or agent frameworks, including tool calling, prompt engineering, or evaluation workflows
  • Interest in learning about agent-assisted engineering tools
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, or cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP
  • Coursework, internships, or personal projects involving:
  • Test automation
  • Data pipelines
  • Artificial intelligence or machine learning
  • Experience using AI coding assistants, with the judgment to critically review and validate generated code
  • Exposure to end-to-end testing or integration framework development

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, either completed, in progress, or recently completed
  • 0–2 years of software engineering experience, including internships, academic projects, or relevant personal projects
  • Demonstrated interest in full-stack development, quality engineering, developer tooling, or software automation

Other Requirements

  • Three positions are available.
  • Six-month contract assignment.
  • Work location: Foster City or San Diego, California.

  • Candidates must be authorized to work under a W-2 arrangement.
  • Start date: As soon as possible.

job.title: Controller
job.description:
Interim Controller

Overview

Lead the accounting function of an established, internationally operating environmental commodities business during an important period of transition and growth. The Interim Controller will oversee a global accounting team of approximately 12 professionals, strengthen accounting processes and controls, and ensure accurate, timely reporting across multiple legal entities.

This role offers the opportunity to make an immediate impact by stabilizing and motivating the accounting team, improving the close and consolidation process, advancing systems integration, supporting audit and compliance requirements, and helping shape the future of the organization’s accounting infrastructure. The ideal candidate is an experienced accounting leader who is comfortable operating in an evolving, startup-like environment and navigating ambiguity with sound judgment.

Required Skills

  • Proven experience leading global corporate accounting, including:
  • Account reconciliations and journal entries
  • Intercompany transactions and eliminations
  • Foreign currency accounting
  • Consolidation and entity-level reporting
  • Balance sheet analysis and fluctuation reporting
  • Demonstrated ability to manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end close processes across multiple entities.
  • Required experience with NetSuite.
  • Strong knowledge of revenue recognition, cost of goods sold, inventory accounting, billing, cash management, and banking processes.
  • Experience overseeing accounting for transactions involving purchases, sales, and inventory positions.
  • Ability to prepare and present close flux analyses to finance and accounting stakeholders.
  • Experience preparing consolidated financial statements and reporting for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong audit management skills, including coordinating information requests, walkthroughs, process reviews, and year-end audit activities.
  • Experience managing lender, compliance, statutory, or other external reporting requirements.
  • Ability to identify and remediate gaps in accounting policies, procedures, controls, and signing authorities.
  • Experience improving accounting systems, processes, standardization, automation, and reporting.
  • Ability to support the integration of international subsidiaries and related third-party systems with an ERP.
  • Strong team leadership skills, including the ability to stabilize, motivate, and develop accounting professionals and offshore contractors.
  • Ability to work effectively in an environment with evolving processes, competing priorities, and incomplete information.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in environmental commodities, energy trading, financial trading, or another transaction-intensive industry.
  • Familiarity with energy trading and risk management systems or other trading settlement platforms.
  • Experience supporting the design, implementation, or rollout of financial systems.
  • Experience with Adaptive or comparable financial planning and analysis tools.
  • Experience managing accounting for international subsidiaries transitioning to stand-alone operating entities.
  • Experience implementing NetSuite automation for consolidations, reconciliations, and other processes performed outside the ERP.
  • Experience supporting capital raises, acquisitions, or other strategic finance initiatives.
  • Experience managing accounting operations during a significant team transition or leave of absence.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Significant experience in a Controller, Corporate Controller, Assistant Controller, or comparable senior accounting leadership role.
  • Experience overseeing accounting for global, multi-entity organizations.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, or startup-like business environment.
  • Preferred educational background and professional certification requirements were not specified.

Other Requirements

  • Engagement: Interim contract expected to last approximately 5–6 months, with potential for extension depending on business needs.
  • Start: ASAP, ideally with transition overlap.
  • Work arrangement: Remote candidates will be considered; availability to work onsite on Thursdays is preferred.
  • Time zone: Pacific Time Zone preferred. Working within the candidate’s local business hours is acceptable.
  • Systems: Direct NetSuite experience is required.
  • Must be available to lead the accounting function through close, audit, reporting, compliance, systems integration, and process improvement priorities.
  • Must be comfortable working collaboratively with finance leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, international teams, and offshore accounting resources.

job.title: Technical Program Manager - Body & Closures
job.description:
Technical Program Manager – Body & Closures

Overview

Working closely with mechanical engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, validation teams, and external suppliers, you will manage schedules, coordinate hardware builds, track technical issues, and help resolve roadblocks across mechanisms, sealing, and structural integration.

  • Experience supporting physical product development lifecycles, including design, sourcing, validation, and build phases
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams
  • Experience building, maintaining, and communicating detailed project schedules
  • Ability to coordinate hardware build plans and track part deliveries with external suppliers
  • Experience maintaining issue or bug trackers, such as Jira, and following up on root-cause analysis activities
  • Ability to facilitate cross-functional meetings and drive hardware issues through resolution
  • Experience coordinating across mechanical engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and validation teams
  • Experience tracking bill of materials maturity
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct packaging investigations or manage clash analysis using 3D CAD tools such as CATIA, NX, or SolidWorks
  • Proficiency managing the release of technical datasets and manufacturing drawings through formal PLM workflows
  • Familiarity with project and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or Microsoft Project

Nice-to-Have Skills

Preferred Education and Experience

job.title: Program Manager - Infrastructure Systems Implementation
job.description:
Program Manager – Infrastructure Systems Implementation

Overview

Lead the implementation of an enterprise infrastructure project management platform across multiple sites and help establish the systems, data, and performance framework that support infrastructure delivery from planning through ongoing operations. In this cross-functional role, you will partner with Infrastructure Operations, Finance, IT, Data, and other teams to translate business workflows into system requirements, guide platform configuration and adoption, and serve as the primary day-to-day liaison with a third-party software vendor.

You will also own the development and implementation of a KPI framework designed to provide visibility into deployment progress, site readiness, infrastructure reliability, and operational performance. This opportunity is well suited to a hands-on program manager who combines infrastructure deployment experience with strong systems implementation, stakeholder management, data analysis, and KPI design capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Gather, document, and prioritize requirements from stakeholders across infrastructure, IT, partnerships, operations, and related teams.
  • Lead implementation of an infrastructure project management platform across all sites.
  • Define software requirements supporting project tracking throughout the site lifecycle.
  • Design the information architecture for centralizing contracts, site plans, permitting documents, vendor records, and other project documentation.
  • Define, configure, and validate KPI tracking and reporting functionality within the platform.
  • Lead user acceptance testing and coordinate feedback between internal stakeholders and the software vendor.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day vendor contact throughout requirements gathering, configuration, testing, and rollout.
  • Develop training materials and drive platform adoption across the infrastructure organization.
  • Manage project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and vendor deliverables.
  • Report project status, risks, and key decisions to leadership.
  • Establish and maintain a KPI framework covering site planning, deployment, operational readiness, and ongoing operations.
  • Define underlying data requirements, validate data quality, and develop reporting that supports clear operational decision-making.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in program or project management, business systems analysis, or software implementation.
  • Experience supporting EV charging, utilities, construction, facilities, infrastructure deployment, or a related environment.
  • Ability to map the full site lifecycle, including permitting, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handoff.
  • Experience designing site and project hierarchies, schedule rollups, milestone tracking, and RAG status reporting.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure deployment tools and project tracking methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of schedule-versus-plan management, milestone tracking, status reporting, and project controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather requirements and translate business workflows into system and data requirements.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently across multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups in an ambiguous environment.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience implementing project management or enterprise software platforms.
  • Experience migrating spreadsheet-based processes and data into an enterprise system.
  • Background in infrastructure, construction, or other deployment-heavy operating environments.
  • Experience designing KPI frameworks, dashboards, and operational reporting.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, training, change management, and system adoption.
  • Experience working directly with third-party software vendors.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, engineering, construction management, operations, or a related field preferred.
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in program management, business systems analysis, software implementation, infrastructure deployment, or a comparable discipline.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid, onsite in Foster City, California four days per week.
  • Engagement: Six-month contract opportunity.
  • Start: ASAP.
  • Must be comfortable coordinating with cross-functional teams and an external software vendor throughout implementation, testing, training, and rollout.

job.title: Candidate Experience Coordinator
job.description:
Candidate Experience Coordinator

Overview

Help shape a seamless, thoughtful, and candidate-centered hiring experience as a Candidate Experience Coordinator. In this role, you’ll own the end-to-end interview experience for assigned candidates, serving as a trusted point of contact from the initial interview request through completion of the hiring process.

You’ll coordinate complex interview schedules across multiple time zones, support onsite experiences, partner closely with recruiters and hiring teams, and proactively resolve logistical challenges before they affect candidates. Beyond coordination, you’ll contribute to the continued evolution of the Candidate Experience function by identifying process improvements, strengthening communication standards, and using candidate feedback and operational insights to create a more effective recruiting journey.

This is a 6-month contract position with potential for conversion, offering the opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a growing, candidate-focused recruiting organization.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • At least 2 years of experience in Recruiting Coordination, Candidate Experience, or Talent Acquisition Operations.
  • Proven ability to manage complex interview scheduling and competing priorities.
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).
  • Experience using interview scheduling platforms.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work independently, solve problems proactively, and exercise sound judgment.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to delivering an exceptional candidate experience.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to handle sensitive candidate and business information with professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.
  • Flexibility to support scheduling across multiple time zones and business needs, including occasional early morning or late afternoon/evening meetings.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with GoodTime or a comparable interview scheduling platform.
  • Experience with Ashby or a similar Applicant Tracking System.
  • Background supporting high-volume, technical, executive, or complex hiring environments.
  • Experience coordinating onsite interviews or other high-touch candidate experiences.
  • Experience contributing to recruiting operations, process improvement, or organizational transformation initiatives.
  • Experience using candidate feedback, service metrics, or operational data to recommend improvements.
  • Interest in building a long-term career in Candidate Experience or Talent Acquisition Operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end interview experience for assigned candidates.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates, providing timely communication and support throughout the interview process.
  • Coordinate multi-round interviews, executive interviews, panel interviews, and schedules involving multiple time zones.
  • Partner with recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and business partners to ensure a seamless candidate experience.
  • Anticipate and proactively resolve scheduling and logistics challenges.
  • Coordinate onsite interviews, including candidate arrivals, interviewer readiness, interview transitions, and real-time troubleshooting.
  • Maintain accurate candidate and scheduling information within ATS and interview scheduling platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, templates, communication standards, and candidate touchpoints.
  • Leverage candidate feedback and operational insights to recommend process improvements.
  • Share best practices and support the continued development of a candidate-centered recruiting coordination function.
  • Build strong working relationships with recruiting and hiring teams while maintaining discretion and confidentiality.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Two or more years of experience in recruiting coordination, candidate experience, or talent acquisition operations preferred.
  • Experience supporting complex scheduling, high-volume recruiting, technical hiring, executive hiring, or onsite interview programs is beneficial.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid in Durham, NC, with onsite work required three days per week.
  • Schedule: Must be flexible to support candidates and interview teams across multiple time zones, including occasional early morning or late afternoon/evening meetings.
  • Employment type: W-2 contract position.
  • Duration: Six-month contract with potential for conversion.
  • Start: ASAP.

job.title: Fleet Support Engineer - Vehicle Motion Control & Safety Controllers
job.description:
Fleet Support Engineer – Vehicle Motion Control & Safety Controllers

Overview

Support the reliability and operational uptime of an advanced vehicle fleet by diagnosing and resolving complex issues involving safety-critical electronic control units (ECUs). As a Fleet Support Engineer, you will serve as a primary technical resource for real-time escalations affecting primary and backup motion-control units, fail-operational systems, controller communications, and safe-stop functionality.

This hands-on role partners closely with engineering, operations, and field teams to perform root cause analysis, implement corrective actions, validate repairs, and develop troubleshooting resources that improve fleet performance. The ideal candidate brings deep embedded systems expertise, strong CAN-bus debugging skills, and the ability to drive problems from high-level vehicle behavior down to component-level detail.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • At least 4 years of relevant experience in transportation, aerospace, autonomous vehicles, or a related field focused on embedded vehicle controllers, motion control, or safety-critical ECUs
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Hands-on experience with embedded ECUs and real-time control systems, including microcontroller-based architectures and state machines
  • Strong understanding of fail-safe and fail-operational architectures, redundant control strategies, and safety-critical systems
  • Ability to interpret electrical schematics, harness diagrams, and state-machine diagrams
  • Experience debugging Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS) issues
  • Extensive experience with CAN architecture and frame-level troubleshooting using tools such as Vector CANalyzer, CANoe, or PCAN
  • Experience diagnosing controller faults, unresponsive or unreachable controllers, failed resets, and stale or locked-up controller messaging
  • Knowledge of command and feedback paths between primary compute systems, motion-control units, and downstream body, thermal, powertrain, and chassis controllers
  • Ability to conduct root cause analysis and implement interim and permanent corrective actions
  • Holistic problem-solving approach, with the ability to connect vehicle-level functions to component-level issues
  • Strong technical documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Proactive, self-directed approach to troubleshooting in real-time service and fleet operations environments
  • Ability to pass a background check and Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • 3 or more years of experience in firmware validation for embedded systems
  • Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation methodologies
  • Experience preparing test plans from firmware requirements or state machines
  • Familiarity with automotive network gateways, including CAN-to-Ethernet and Diagnostics over Internet Protocol (DoIP) communication
  • Strong understanding of embedded controls, state machines, controller takeover and arbitration logic, and physical sensor and actuator interfaces
  • Experience providing remote support for vehicle troubleshooting
  • Experience with Linux and Python-based systems for fleet-level data processing
  • Experience validating component and vehicle bring-up, functional verification, and controller firmware alignment following replacement or repair

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • Four or more years of relevant experience with embedded vehicle controllers, motion control, safety-critical ECUs, or real-time control systems
  • Experience supporting complex vehicle systems in transportation, aerospace, autonomous vehicle, or comparable safety-critical environments

Other Requirements

  • Onsite position in Foster City, California
  • W2 employment only
  • Six-month contract assignment
  • Availability for night and weekend shifts as needed, with advance notice
  • Occasional travel to support operations at various locations
  • Ability to support real-time fleet escalations and collaborate effectively across engineering, operations, and field teams

job.title: Manufacturing Quality Technician
job.description:
Manufacturing Quality Technician

Overview

Support the quality and reliability of high-volume vehicle manufacturing as a Manufacturing Quality Technician. In this onsite role, you will perform quality inspections throughout General Assembly and End of Line operations, identify and document nonconformities, and collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, Vehicle Engineering, Corporate Quality, Supplier Quality, Operations, and Repair teams to resolve issues efficiently.

Your technical expertise will help maintain high manufacturing standards, validate completed rework, identify quality trends, and support triage, containment, and root cause analysis across the production environment.

Required Skills

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Quality Technician
  • Experience in automotive manufacturing, particularly high-volume production
  • Ability to perform in-line quality inspections in General Assembly and End of Line environments
  • Ability to read technical drawings and specifications in CAD
  • Broad technical knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems
  • Experience with:
  • Triage and root cause analysis
  • Implementing containments
  • PFMEAs
  • Control Plans
  • Inspection documents
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to communicate inspection findings, production roadblocks, and quality concerns clearly to cross-functional teams
  • Ability to use quality gages and inspection tools
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to manufacturing quality

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Associate degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering
  • 7+ years of technician experience in high-volume automotive manufacturing
  • Experience with MES, SAP, or Ignition systems
  • Basic understanding of GD&T principles
  • Experience interpreting metrology reports
  • Experience developing inspection training plans, quality standards, and quality alerts
  • Familiarity with Factory Gate processes and quality documentation verification

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred education: Associate degree in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering
  • Preferred experience: 5 or more years as a Quality Technician, with automotive manufacturing experience strongly preferred
  • Candidates with 7 or more years of experience in high-volume automotive manufacturing are especially well suited for this role

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully onsite in Hayward, California
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. during production hours
  • Regular evening overtime may be required, potentially extending shifts until 6:00 p.m.
  • Overtime on approximately 1–2 Saturdays per month may also be expected
  • Candidates must be flexible to support production needs and occasional overtime
  • Assignment duration: 6 months
  • W2 employment only

job.title: Fleet Support Engineer
job.description:
Fleet Support Engineer

Overview

Support the operational uptime and reliability of an advanced vehicle fleet as a Fleet Support Engineer on the Base Operations team. In this hands-on, onsite role, you’ll serve as a technical expert and primary point of contact for real-time fleet escalations, using log analysis, hardware validation, diagnostic procedures, and cross-functional collaboration to identify issues and drive lasting solutions. Your work will directly improve vehicle performance, troubleshooting efficiency, and fleet-wide reliability.

Required Skills

  • 2–4 years of relevant experience in transportation, aerospace, autonomous vehicles, or a related technical environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience with low- and high-voltage circuits and safe troubleshooting practices
  • Knowledge of Unified Diagnostic Services (UDS)
  • Understanding of hardware and software system architecture and vehicle communications
  • Ability to perform root cause analysis through comprehensive log and fleet data review
  • Ability to understand schematics, electrical diagrams, connector end views, and pinouts
  • Ability to troubleshoot high-level vehicle functions and identify resolution paths at the component level
  • Strong technical documentation and communication skills
  • Ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively across engineering, operations, and design teams
  • Self-starter with a holistic, solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with electric vehicle technology
  • Experience remotely supporting vehicle troubleshooting
  • Knowledge of vehicle systems and diagnostic tools
  • Experience with Linux and Python-based systems for fleet-level data processing
  • Experience working with software that interfaces with hardware
  • Familiarity with networking, TCP, and socket programming
  • Experience developing diagnostic procedures, troubleshooting guides, or fleet-wide countermeasures

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline
  • 2–4 years of professional experience in transportation, aerospace, autonomous vehicles, electric vehicles, or comparable technical operations
  • Experience supporting complex hardware and software systems in an operational environment

Other Requirements

  • This is an onsite position in Foster City, California.
  • Availability to work night and weekend shifts as needed, with advance notice.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally within the United States to support operational locations.
  • W2 employment only.
  • Ability to support a six-month assignment with an ASAP start.

job.title: Electrical Engineering Technician
job.description:
Electrical Engineering Technician | Wire Harness Testing & Rework

Overview

Support critical wire harness testing operations across multiple harness programs, including body, high-speed, and roof applications. In this hands-on onsite role, you’ll operate electrical test equipment, inspect connectors and terminals, troubleshoot electrical and physical defects, perform basic connector-level rework, and collaborate with operators, engineering, and quality teams. Your ability to distinguish genuine harness defects from test-fixture artifacts will help ensure accurate results and support reliable engineering decisions.

Required Skills

  • Experience operating electrical test equipment and troubleshooting wire harnesses, electrical systems, or electromechanical assemblies
  • Ability to read and cross-reference 2D electrical and wire harness engineering drawings and wire lists
  • Proficiency using a multimeter to investigate opens, shorts, miswires, and resistance issues
  • Ability to visually inspect connectors and terminals using magnification or similar inspection tools
  • Sound engineering judgment, including the ability to identify potential test-fixture artifacts, confirm defects, and determine when escalation is appropriate
  • Ability to perform basic connector rework, including:
  • Removing and replacing clips, secondary locks, and terminals
  • Reseating or re-terminating wires
  • Clear written documentation and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with operators, engineering, and quality teams
  • Ability to stand, bend, reach, and work in physical positions for extended periods
  • Ability to lift and carry up to approximately 30 pounds
  • Ability to participate in a two- to three-person harness loading and unloading process
  • Willingness and ability to work onsite in Hayward, CA

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Cirris Easy-Wire or a similar cable and wire harness testing system
  • Experience using a four-wire (Kelvin) milliohmmeter
  • Experience with borescopes or other visual-inspection equipment
  • IPC/WHMA-A-620 certification or equivalent wire harness workmanship training
  • Experience working with multiple harness types or vehicle subsystems, such as body, high-speed data, and roof harnesses
  • Background in automotive, aerospace, or similar manufacturing environments

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Associate’s degree or technical certificate in Electronics, Electrical Technology, Avionics, or a related field
  • At least two years of hands-on experience in wire harness testing, electrical troubleshooting, electromechanical assembly, or rework
  • Equivalent hands-on experience may be considered in place of formal education

Other Requirements

  • This is a fully onsite position in Hayward, CA.
  • The assignment duration is 12 months, with an ASAP start.
  • Must be able to assist with harness fixture setup and breakdown, including loading, connecting, disconnecting, unloading, labeling, and organizing test equipment and work areas.
  • Must be willing to cross-train across multiple harness programs and adapt testing and troubleshooting practices to different fixtures and harness types.
  • Training on the Cirris Easy-Wire system is available for candidates without prior experience.

job.title: Principal Engineer, System HW Design - SI/PI
job.description:
Principal Engineer, System HW Design – Signal Integrity / Power Integrity (SI/PI)

Overview

Lead the signal integrity and power integrity strategy for a portfolio of advanced machine-learning hardware platforms. As Principal Engineer, System HW Design – SI/PI, you will help design, build, bring up, characterize, and productize PCB systems spanning System-on-Module designs, PCIe add-in cards, chip-down BGA reference designs, development kits, and future platforms.

This high-impact technical leadership role is ideal for an engineer who can establish organization-wide SI/PI standards, guide complex board designs, close high-speed interface margins, and resolve the most challenging lab validation and bring-up issues. You will collaborate across ASIC, package, hardware, layout, firmware, manufacturing, and external vendor teams to deliver reliable high-speed signaling and power delivery for advanced compute systems.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • Approximately 15 years of industry experience in signal integrity and power integrity engineering for high-speed digital systems.
  • Experience leading SI/PI strategy across multiple concurrent hardware programs.
  • Deep expertise with:
  • PCIe Gen4/Gen5, including PCIe Gen5 operation up to 32 GT/s per lane.
  • DDR4, DDR5, and LPDDR memory channels.
  • USB 3.x and USB Type-C.
  • MIPI D-PHY and C-PHY.
  • 10 Gigabit Ethernet SerDes.
  • Proven experience driving high-speed interface margin closure on production designs.
  • Demonstrated experience owning power delivery network architecture for high-power SoCs, ASICs, AI accelerators, GPUs, or comparable compute silicon.
  • Expert proficiency with SI/PI EDA tools such as Ansys HFSS/SIwave, Cadence Sigrity/Clarity, Keysight ADS, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience selecting SI/PI tools and developing reusable simulation methodologies.
  • Extensive hands-on lab validation experience using VNAs, TDRs, and high-bandwidth oscilloscopes.
  • Experience owning escalation-level SI/PI debug.
  • Expertise in PCB stack-up design, impedance control, transmission line theory, S-parameters, and channel modeling.
  • Strong working knowledge of PCIe-SIG, USB-IF, and MIPI Alliance compliance standards.
  • Ability to define technical direction, establish engineering standards, and mentor senior- and staff-level engineers.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align ASIC, package, hardware, layout, and firmware teams.
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Knowledge of ASIC characterization, PCB manufacturing, assembly, test, quality, and reliability.
  • Experience supporting or owning PCIe-SIG, USB-IF, or MIPI Alliance compliance testing.
  • Experience defining connector and interconnect strategies across multiple product generations.
  • Experience working with board-to-board, M.2 NVMe, and PCIe edge-card interfaces.
  • Experience engaging with component and module vendors or industry standards organizations.
  • A record of delivering complex technical programs in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Creative and intellectually curious approach to solving challenging hardware problems.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field preferred.

job.title: Sr. Financial Analyst or Finance Manager
job.description:
Senior Financial Analyst / Finance Manager – Marketing & GTM Finance

Overview

A publicly traded, high-tech SaaS organization is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst or Finance Manager to support its Marketing and Go-to-Market finance function on a contract basis. This high-impact role will partner directly with senior Marketing leadership and collaborate with multiple Vice Presidents to evaluate spending priorities, strengthen financial reporting, and provide strategic analysis that supports business decisions.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on finance professional who can manage budgeting and forecasting, assess return on investment, reconcile financial data, and provide sound guidance in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. This is a 100% remote opportunity with an anticipated start date of 12/01/2026 and an initial duration of 2–6 months, with potential for extension as the organization evaluates its long-term needs.

Required Skills

  • Experience with budgeting and forecasting for Marketing and/or Go-to-Market functions
  • Experience developing and reporting on an Annual Operating Plan (AOP)
  • Strong financial analysis, reporting, and data-reconciliation skills
  • Ability to investigate discrepancies between accruals and actuals
  • Experience evaluating Marketing spend, business initiatives, and event performance
  • Ability to analyze pipeline generated and assess the return on investment of strategic investments
  • Strong Excel skills and experience working with large datasets
  • Ability to manage ad hoc financial requests and collaborate effectively with cross-functional business partners
  • Strong judgment, ownership, and attention to detail
  • Ability to review purchase orders and accruals, support reconciliations, answer questions, and provide guidance to a junior Financial Analyst
  • Experience building sales quotas for territories
  • Ability to provide direction, mentorship, and hands-on support to junior team members

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with NetSuite
  • Experience with Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, or a similar financial planning and analysis platform
  • Public company experience and familiarity with related financial processes and best practices
  • High-tech or SaaS industry experience
  • Experience partnering directly with a Chief Marketing Officer or other senior executive
  • Experience consolidating spending requests across multiple Marketing leaders and assessing financial feasibility against an overall budget
  • Experience with OfficeConnect or similar tools used to extract and analyze financial data in Excel

Preferred Education and Experience

The provided role details do not specify a required educational background. Candidates should bring relevant experience in financial analysis, FP&A, Marketing finance, Go-to-Market finance, or a closely related function, with a level of expertise aligned with either a Senior Financial Analyst or Finance Manager position.

Experience in public companies, high-tech or SaaS organizations, Marketing finance, and strategic financial analysis is preferred but not required.

Other Requirements

  • Engagement: Contract position
  • Anticipated start date: 12/01/2026
  • Initial duration: 2–6 months, with potential for extension
  • The role requires the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and provide practical financial guidance in a changing environment.

job.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
job.description:
Revenue Operations Analyst

Support the accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of a high-impact go-to-market organization as a Revenue Operations Analyst. In this role, you will structure and validate sales opportunities, interpret customer agreements, complete pricing calculations, and ensure deals are booked in alignment with company policies and SaaS revenue guidelines.

Working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Accounting, Billing, FP&A, and Sales Operations, you will help improve deal execution, revenue reporting, forecasting, operational processes, and data integrity. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact by advising internal teams on deal structure, approvals, bookings, and process improvements.

Position Details:

  • Contract duration: Approximately 4 months
  • Anticipated start date: 11/23/2026
  • Location: San Francisco, CA, or remote
  • Work arrangement: Remote work is intended; onsite expectations will be confirmed

Required Skills

  • Experience supporting revenue operations, deal desk, sales operations, business operations, or a related function
  • Ability to review, interpret, and understand complex customer agreements and legal contracts
  • Experience structuring and validating sales opportunities in Salesforce
  • Knowledge of booking policies, SaaS revenue guidelines, and revenue recognition considerations
  • Ability to extract contract data and accurately complete pricing calculations using relevant tools and systems of record
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate deal structures and provide clear recommendations
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Accounting, Billing, FP&A, and Sales Operations
  • Ability to maintain accurate and reliable sales data in Salesforce and related revenue systems
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through when managing multiple deal reviews and approvals
  • Ability to manage operational inquiries and resolve requests within established service-level agreements
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain policies, procedures, and booking guidelines to internal stakeholders

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting pricing strategy initiatives or gathering market and pricing intelligence
  • Experience developing pricing models for new business and customer expansion opportunities
  • Familiarity with deal desk operations, bookings analysis, forecasting impacts, and revenue recognition
  • Experience documenting and maintaining sales policies and operational processes across business units or geographic regions
  • Background supporting reporting, pipeline metrics, bookings analysis, sales enablement tools, or KPI standardization
  • Experience coordinating approvals with Legal, Security, Tax, Data Ethics, Insurance, or similar internal stakeholders
  • Experience providing training or guidance on Salesforce opportunity structure and best practices
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and implement operational best practices that improve efficiency

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Relevant education in business, finance, accounting, operations, or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Experience in revenue operations, deal desk, sales operations, pricing operations, SaaS finance, or a closely related field is preferred.
  • Specific degree requirements and minimum years of experience were not provided.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and collaborate across multiple functions and teams
  • Availability to support time-sensitive deal reviews, including end-of-quarter activities
  • Ability to manage competing priorities while meeting established service-level agreements
  • Strong commitment to data accuracy, process consistency, and confidentiality when handling customer agreements and business information
  • Ability to support accurate and timely bookings, reporting, approvals, and revenue operations activities throughout the contract assignment
