job.title: Stock Administration Consultant (Part Time, Remote)
job.description:
Stock Administration Consultant (Part Time, Remote)

Overview

Support the accurate and efficient administration of an equity compensation program in this high-impact consulting role. The Stock Administration Consultant will serve as the primary day-to-day administrator of the company’s equity management platform, managing transactions, reporting, vesting activity, and related documentation for an employee and director population of 60+.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced stock administration professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, works independently, and can quickly take ownership of critical processes. The consultant will collaborate with Legal, Payroll, Accounting, and Finance to ensure equity activity is accurately recorded, aligned with board approvals, and supported by effective policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and process equity transactions in Certent by insightsoftware, including:
  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Restricted Stock Awards (RSAs)
  • Performance Stock Units (PSUs)
  • Warrants
  • Forfeitures
  • Track PSU milestones and related award activity.
  • Process vested equity award releases, including sell-to-cover calculations and payroll coordination.
  • Prepare monthly rollforward reports reflecting equity and share balances, grants, vesting activity, and forfeitures.
  • Reconcile cap table activity and maintain accurate equity records.
  • Ensure equity-related transactions are properly documented and aligned with board approvals.
  • Coordinate data flow and process accuracy across Legal, Payroll, Accounting, and Finance.
  • Develop and improve policies, procedures, and operating processes related to stock administration and key SOX process areas.
  • Support accurate reporting, compliance, and ongoing administration of the equity compensation program.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience administering equity or stock compensation programs.
  • Experience with Certent by insightsoftware is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of RSUs, RSAs, PSUs, warrants, vesting, and forfeitures.
  • Experience reconciling cap tables and preparing grant, vesting, forfeiture, and equity rollforward reports.
  • Familiarity with board approval documentation and equity transaction controls.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proactive communication and strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and deliver results with minimal direction.
  • Capacity to quickly assume ownership in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Background in accounting or familiarity with stock-based compensation accounting.
  • Experience supporting audits or financial reporting processes.
  • Exposure to ERP systems, particularly NetSuite.
  • Experience developing policies, procedures, or SOX-related process documentation.
  • Experience supporting equity administration within a public company or a company that has recently completed a public-market transaction.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Relevant education and professional experience in stock administration, equity compensation, accounting, finance, or a related discipline are preferred.
  • Prior hands-on experience managing equity programs and administering transactions through Certent is highly valued.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: 100% remote.
  • Schedule: Approximately 6–12 hours per week, with flexible scheduling and consistent availability during the business week.
  • Engagement: Indefinite consulting engagement.
  • Start: As soon as possible.
  • Must be able to independently support ongoing equity administration while maintaining responsiveness and accuracy across a distributed team.

job.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - Supply Chain
job.description:
Senior Technical Project Manager – Supply Chain / Source-to-Pay

Overview

Lead complex, cross-functional technology initiatives that improve the systems and processes supporting Supply Chain and Source-to-Pay operations. This senior-level contract role will help optimize a procurement technology ecosystem, address platform functionality and user experience challenges, and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.

You will work across engineering, procurement, supply chain, finance, and other business teams to bring structure to complex initiatives, manage competing priorities, and drive programs from planning through execution. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, highly organized leader who can influence without direct authority, navigate evolving priorities, and combine strong technical program management discipline with business and product-oriented thinking.

  • Work across the Source-to-Pay lifecycle and related upstream and downstream processes.
  • Partner with engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical deliverables.
  • Create, refine, and maintain business requirements documents.
  • Help stakeholders and platform super users articulate technical requirements and document requested changes.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on business impact, technical dependencies, and organizational objectives.
  • Build strong relationships across engineering, procurement, supply chain, finance, and other internal teams.
  • Facilitate communication among geographically distributed stakeholders.
  • Identify misalignment, resolve conflicts, de-escalate challenging situations, and build consensus.
  • Influence stakeholders without direct authority and maintain a customer-focused mindset for internal platform users.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with Jira Cloud, including:
  • Setting up and organizing projects and programs.
  • Breaking initiatives into milestones, deliverables, and actionable workstreams.
  • Tracking dependencies, risks, issues, and project progress.
  • Maintaining accurate, organized, and actionable project documentation.
  • Experience managing risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies through RAID processes.
  • Strong understanding of the distinction between project and program management and how initiatives align with broader portfolio objectives.
  • Experience gathering, documenting, and translating business requirements into actionable technical deliverables.
  • Ability to create, refine, and maintain business requirements documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical teams.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and organizational skills.
  • Strong emotional intelligence and the ability to navigate challenging stakeholder relationships.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders, build consensus, resolve conflicts, and de-escalate difficult situations.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership, and drive initiatives forward with limited direction.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving technology environment with shifting priorities.
  • Ability to understand technical discussions, system integrations, dependencies, and business requirements.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Coupa, particularly in procurement or Source-to-Pay environments.
  • Familiarity with NetSuite and enterprise system integrations.
  • Understanding of Source-to-Pay processes and related procurement, finance, and supply chain workflows.
  • Experience with enterprise platform implementations, post-implementation optimization, or technology transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working closely with engineering organizations to translate business needs into technical execution plans.
  • Exposure to product management methodologies and practices.
  • Experience optimizing platform functionality, workflows, processes, and user experiences.

Direct Coupa experience is a significant advantage but is not required. Strong technical program management capabilities and relevant domain familiarity are highly valued.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Preferred educational background is not specified.
  • Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in technical program management, technology project management, enterprise technology delivery, or a closely related field is preferred.
  • Experience supporting enterprise platforms, integrations, or Supply Chain and Source-to-Pay technology initiatives is strongly preferred.
  • Experience operating as an experienced, independent contributor in complex and evolving environments is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid.
  • Location: Sunnyvale, California.
  • Ability to work onsite approximately two to three days per week as needed.
  • Candidates should be based in or willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area.
  • Ability to collaborate with geographically distributed teams, including East Coast stakeholders, which may require occasional early-morning meetings.

Lead the full lifecycle of complex enterprise procurement contracts in a high-impact, fast-paced environment.   • Demonstrated ability to independently draft, review, and negotiate complex, high-value commercial agreements
  • Experience managing the end-to-end contracting process, from intake and strategic planning through execution and post-signature review
  • Strong understanding of commercial contract law, data security, and privacy regulations, including GDPR and CCPA
  • Ability to identify, assess, communicate, and mitigate contractual, legal, and commercial risks
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to develop creative solutions and provide sound recommendations to cross-functional and business leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

  • Highly organized and detail oriented, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives independently
  • Experience using contract management tools and systems to improve workflow efficiency, data integrity, and lifecycle visibility
  • Ability to work effectively in a high-paced, high-expectation environment while maintaining professionalism and accuracy

As the International Payroll Specialist – APAC, you will manage monthly payroll for Australia and Singapore, lead the launch of South Korea payroll, oversee Japan payroll activities, and partner with global teams and external providers to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely employee payments.

This role is ideal for an experienced international payroll professional who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoys building processes from the ground up, and can balance day-to-day payroll execution with international implementations and continuous improvement. You will develop country-specific runbooks, maintain the APAC compliance calendar, reconcile payroll registers to Workday, support provider relationships, and help ensure a consistent employee experience across multiple countries.

  • South Korea

  • Superannuation guarantee
  • Single Touch Payroll (STP)
  • State payroll tax
  • Working knowledge of Singapore payroll requirements, including:

  • Experience running payroll through an outsourced provider and reviewing provider output
  • Ability to reconcile payroll registers to an HRIS, preferably Workday; investigate variances; and confirm funding
  • Experience processing new hires, terminations, final pay, one-time payments, commissions, and reimbursements
  • Strong process documentation and organizational skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with US-based teams and vendors across multiple time zones
  • Strong judgment when handling confidential payroll and employee data
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced startup environment

Nice to Have Skills

  • Japanese or Korean language skills
  • Experience with weConnect, Breeze, SmartHR, or ADP Celergo
  • Experience with Workday Payroll or Workday HCM integrations with local payroll providers
  • Experience working for a high-growth technology company expanding into new countries

Overview

Drive the data, models, and insights behind critical renewal decisions in this hands-on Senior Analyst contract role. You’ll build and maintain the FY’27 Available to Renew (ATR) model, support a weekly renewal forecasting process, and partner with Renewals, Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations stakeholders to improve forecast accuracy and data integrity.

This opportunity is ideal for a technically strong business intelligence or analytics professional with experience in data warehouses, business systems, and recurring forecasting workflows. You’ll work closely with account owners and business leaders to ensure reporting reflects real-world account activity while translating complex data into clear, leadership-ready analysis.

Required Skills

  • At least five years of experience in Renewals Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, business intelligence, or a similar go-to-market analytics function.
  • Experience building or owning a recurring forecasting process.
  • Deep Salesforce and Snowflake experience, particularly with renewal opportunities, quoting, and record linking.
  • Ability to identify and resolve data issues, including linking gaps, debooks, amendments, and unlinked renewal data.
  • Working fluency with Google Colab or a comparable notebook-based scripting environment; Python experience is preferred.
  • Experience maintaining and troubleshooting analytics workflows using tools such as Alteryx.
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets modeling skills.
  • Ability to build, test, validate, maintain, and document forecasting models and workflows.
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to explain forecast movement and account-level changes in concise narratives for senior leaders.
  • Comfort working within a weekly forecasting cadence and delivering accurate inputs despite imperfect or changing data.
  • Ability to work independently with limited ramp time, prioritize competing requests, and document work thoroughly.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Direct experience building or maintaining an Available to Renew model or comparable renewal-tracking model.
  • Experience supporting a SaaS or education technology renewals organization.
  • Background in renewals analytics, sales operations, or revenue operations.
  • Experience working in a matrixed organization.
  • Experience supporting renewal-save initiatives or at-risk account analysis.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce corrections, forecast walks, week-over-week dashboards, and leadership forecasting tools.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • No specific educational background is required in the available role information.
  • Five or more years of relevant experience in renewals operations, revenue operations, sales operations, business intelligence, or a comparable analytics role is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote; candidates may work from any time zone.
  • Engagement: Contract role initially planned for three months, with a strong likelihood of extension beyond one year.
  • Build, validate, and document the FY’27 ATR model so it can be maintained by the broader team.
  • Refresh and troubleshoot the ATR data pull and associated notebook-based workflows.
  • Support weekly renewal forecasts, forecast walks, dashboard updates, and forecasting tools used by business leaders.
  • Partner effectively with Renewals, Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.
  • Respond to ad hoc analytical requests and provide timely, accurate deliverables.
  • Maintain strong documentation to support effective knowledge transfer at the end of the engagement.

job.title: Senior Store Planner
job.description:
Senior Store Planner

Overview

Lead the planning and execution of retail projects spanning new store openings, relocations, expansions, remodels, and special initiatives. As a Senior Store Planner, you’ll guide projects from site evaluation and pre-development planning through fixture planning and final architectural criteria, balancing operational needs, brand standards, site constraints, and construction requirements.

This role partners closely with Real Estate, Construction, Store Operations, Design, landlords, architects, consultants, and other stakeholders to develop practical, high-quality planning solutions. You’ll manage a diverse project portfolio, provide technical expertise to the broader team, identify and resolve planning challenges, and help drive consistent, efficient execution across projects.

Required Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in retail store planning, architecture, interior design, space planning, design development, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of REVIT; REVIT usage and project applications must be clearly demonstrated on the resume or in the resume summary.
  • Working knowledge of ACAD/AUTOCAD.
  • Experience with retail store and fixture layouts preferred; architectural firm experience will also be considered.
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Retail store planning and fixture layouts
  • Operational requirements and department adjacencies
  • Architectural principles and construction processes
  • Space allocation and utilization strategies
  • Building systems, lease requirements, accessibility standards, and applicable building codes
  • Experience evaluating sites and developing preliminary planning solutions.
  • Ability to interpret surveys, lease requirements, landlord criteria, construction constraints, and other project information.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with cross-functional teams and external project partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to independently evaluate planning issues, recommend solutions, manage project milestones, and escalate significant risks appropriately.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience supporting retail development projects from site evaluation through final design documentation.
  • Proficiency with Bluebeam.
  • Experience applying chain-specific prototypes, fixture standards, architectural criteria, and planning guidelines.
  • Experience coordinating with landlords, architects, consultants, and construction teams.
  • Background contributing to process improvements, planning standards, or department best practices.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Associate degree in Architecture, Architectural Engineering Technology, Interior Design, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Equivalent certificate and relevant professional experience may be considered.
  • Bachelor’s degree or additional education in a related discipline is beneficial.
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in retail store planning, architectural planning, interior design, or space planning.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid.
  • Location: Marlborough, MA.
  • Onsite schedule: Tuesday and Wednesday onsite each week.
  • Work schedule: 36.25-hour work week.
  • Employment type: Contract-to-hire.
  • Must be eligible for W2 employment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with onsite and remote project stakeholders.
  • Must be able to manage multiple active projects and meet established planning milestones and quality standards.

job.title: Senior Accountant - Revenue and Reporting
job.description:
Senior Accountant – Revenue & Reporting

Overview

A healthcare organization in Fremont, CA, is seeking a detail-oriented Senior Accountant – Revenue & Reporting to support revenue accounting, financial reporting, reimbursement analysis, and regulatory activities. This role will play a key part in analyzing net patient service revenue, maintaining contractual allowance and reserve calculations, reconciling patient accounts receivable activity, and preparing accurate financial reports for management review.

The ideal candidate combines strong accounting fundamentals with advanced Excel skills, analytical judgment, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with Revenue Cycle, Finance, audit, and regulatory teams. This is a hybrid, contract-to-hire opportunity with an anticipated initial contract period of two to three months.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze monthly net patient service revenue, calculate contractual allowances, and prepare related revenue adjustment journal entries.
  • Conduct revenue analysis and prepare explanations for monthly and year-to-date budget-to-actual variances.
  • Assist with maintaining and refining contractual allowance models, revenue reserve calculations, and related accounting methodologies.
  • Partner with Revenue Cycle and Finance teams to research and resolve reimbursement discrepancies, payment issues, and other revenue-related matters.
  • Perform general ledger reconciliations, including patient accounts receivable reserves, contractual allowances, and other revenue-related accounts.
  • Prepare monthly financial reports, account schedules, and supporting documentation for management review.
  • Reconcile the Epic accounts receivable subledger to the general ledger on a monthly basis and research discrepancies as needed.
  • Support the annual financial audit process by preparing audit schedules, compiling supporting documentation, and responding to auditor inquiries.
  • Prepare and coordinate supporting schedules for Medicare and Medicaid cost reports.
  • Assist with regulatory filings, including HCAI reports and other reimbursement-related submissions.
  • Support reimbursement audits, desk reviews, and inquiries from governmental and regulatory agencies.
  • Cross-train and provide support in other functional areas as needed.
  • Maintain the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive financial and organizational information.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • At least three years of public accounting experience or healthcare/hospital accounting experience.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, complex formulas, and data analysis.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret complex financial data and communicate findings clearly.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Positive, proactive, and solutions-oriented approach.
  • Sound judgment when communicating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Consistent reliability, punctuality, and attendance.
  • Ability to accept direction and feedback constructively while taking ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with healthcare accounting, hospital finance, reimbursement, or revenue cycle operations.
  • Familiarity with hospital reimbursement methodologies, contractual allowances, and net patient revenue accounting.
  • Experience using Workday Financials and Epic.
  • CPA certification or active progress toward CPA licensure.
  • Experience supporting Medicare and Medicaid cost reports, HCAI reports, reimbursement audits, or regulatory reviews.
  • Public accounting experience with healthcare clients.
  • Experience preparing audit schedules and supporting annual financial audits.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline is required.
  • Three or more years of relevant public accounting or healthcare/hospital accounting experience is required.
  • Healthcare accounting, hospital reimbursement, and revenue reporting experience are strongly preferred.
  • CPA certification or progress toward CPA licensure is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid; onsite in Fremont, CA, three days per week.
  • Employment type: Contract-to-hire, with an anticipated initial contract period of two to three months.
  • Must handle confidential financial and organizational information with discretion.
  • Must communicate professionally and tailor the level of detail to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Must be willing to cross-train and provide support in other functional areas as needed.

job.title: Production Technician
job.description:
Production Technician

Overview

Take ownership of hands-on production work that helps bring reliable electromechanical systems to life. As a Production Technician, you will complete mechanical, electrical, and electromechanical assembly and testing from start to finish while meeting production schedules and maintaining rigorous quality standards. You’ll build from approved work instructions, document progress, identify and escalate blockers, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve issues. Your craftsmanship, attention to detail, and commitment to safe work practices will play an important role in supporting reliable, scalable production.

Required Skills

  • Experience performing mechanical, electrical, and/or electromechanical assembly
  • Ability to conduct testing of assembled systems and components
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality workmanship
  • Ability to follow approved work instructions and established manufacturing processes
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to identify, communicate, and escalate production blockers
  • Effective problem-solving skills and a hands-on approach to troubleshooting
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Commitment to following safety procedures and operating requirements
  • Ability to work effectively in a production environment and meet established schedules

Nice to Have Skills

The available job information does not specify additional preferred skills or experience beyond the required qualifications.

Preferred Education and Experience

The available job information does not specify a preferred educational background or required experience level. Candidates should demonstrate the hands-on assembly, testing, problem-solving, documentation, and safety capabilities outlined above.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully onsite in South San Francisco, California
  • Employment type: W2 only
  • Contract duration: 6 months
  • Anticipated start: ASAP
  • Must be able to work safely with electromechanical systems and comply with all applicable safety and operating procedures

job.title: Sr. Data and Automation Engineer, Enterprise Applications
job.description:
Sr. Data and Automation Engineer, Enterprise Applications

Overview

Build the data products and automation that help critical business teams make faster, more informed decisions. As a hands-on Senior Data and Automation Engineer, you will connect enterprise applications across Finance, Human Resources, Procurement, Legal, Compliance, and Commercial Operations using Databricks, Snowflake, and related analytics platforms.

You will work independently with business stakeholders to transform complex requirements into trusted, governed datasets, reliable integrations, actionable dashboards, and scalable automation. This six-month engagement is focused on delivering documented data products and sustainable solutions that long-term support teams can confidently maintain.

What You’ll Deliver

  • Curated, documented data products supporting use cases such as expense management, learning analytics, gross-to-net reporting, budgeting, and operational reporting.
  • Reliable pipelines and integrations connecting enterprise applications and third-party sources to governed datasets.
  • Dashboards, metrics, and reporting products for broad General and Administrative (G&A) functions.
  • Data quality checks, definitions, documentation, and standards that make enterprise data accessible and trustworthy.
  • Automation and integration solutions—or clearly defined roadmaps—to reduce manual data preparation, reconciliation, reporting, and workflow handoffs.
  • Handoff documentation and support-ready solutions designed to remain adaptable as enterprise systems evolve.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and delivery of curated data products across Databricks, Snowflake, and related platforms.
  • Develop ingestion, transformation, data quality, and reusable data modeling solutions.
  • Partner with G&A business owners to define analytics requirements, key performance indicators, data definitions, and priority use cases.
  • Build pipelines and integrations using APIs, flat files, middleware, Fivetran or similar ingestion tools, and third-party data sources.
  • Create dashboards, metrics layers, and insight products for functions including Finance, Human Resources, Procurement, Legal, Compliance, and Commercial Operations.
  • Establish standards for data naming, lineage, documentation, access controls, data quality, and long-term support handoff.
  • Identify and deliver automation opportunities using Workato, Moveworks, middleware, or similar platforms.
  • Evaluate and responsibly apply artificial intelligence tools to simplify processes, improve data stewardship, and accelerate analytics delivery.
  • Collaborate with Information Security, Compliance, Legal, and data owners to protect sensitive information and align with privacy, governance, and access requirements.
  • Translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical requirements, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Databricks
  • Snowflake
  • SQL
  • Python or PySpark
  • Delta Lake
  • Fivetran or similar data ingestion tools
  • Modern data lakehouse or data warehouse patterns
  • Experience designing curated datasets, semantic models, data quality rules, and documentation for business users.
  • Experience integrating enterprise data through APIs, flat files, middleware, or integration platform as a service (iPaaS) tools.
  • Experience with reporting platforms and reverse extract, transform, load (reverse ETL) or data activation patterns.
  • Familiarity with G&A processes and systems, including NetSuite, Coupa, Concur, Workday Adaptive, Ironclad, Emtrain, ComplianceWire, or similar platforms supporting Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, Legal, learning, compliance, or planning functions.
  • Experience using Workato, Moveworks, middleware, iPaaS, or comparable automation and integration platforms.
  • Ability to convert complex or ambiguous business needs into practical technical requirements and delivery plans.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with business, technology, compliance, and security partners.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with ERP platforms beyond NetSuite.
  • Experience supporting system migrations or re-pointing integrations and data pipelines as applications change.
  • Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or another regulated environment.
  • Experience delivering analytics across multiple G&A functions, including expense management, learning, and workforce metrics.
  • Experience with Unity Catalog, Snowflake governance, workflow orchestration, data lineage, data governance, or access management.
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence, machine learning, or generative AI to analytics workflows, automation, knowledge retrieval, or operational process improvement.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.
  • Equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, enterprise analytics, business systems, integration, automation, or data product delivery.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid in Redwood City, California.
  • Engagement: Six-month contract with potential to convert.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Start: ASAP.
  • Ability to work with sensitive enterprise data in alignment with applicable privacy, governance, security, and access requirements.

job.title: AI Product Video Creator
job.description:
AI Product Video Creator

Overview

Create the videos that make cutting-edge AI products impossible to ignore. As an AI Product Video Creator, you’ll transform working AI applications, tools, games, and web prototypes into polished, high-energy demo videos built for social engagement.

You’ll own the creative video process from recording and editing through sound design and final export. Your work will showcase interactive AI products through seamless motion, crisp pacing, intentional visual storytelling, and premium production quality—capturing attention within the first two seconds.

You will not be expected to write code. Technical AI builders will provide functional interactive products; your role is to bring those creations to life through compelling visuals and ready-to-post social content.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Proven experience creating software demos, technology showcases, feature launches, or tech sizzle reels
  • Portfolio featuring two to three end-to-end software demos or technology sizzle reels that generated strong organic engagement
  • Exceptional eye for pacing, visual hierarchy, camera choreography, typography, and sound design
  • Expertise with one or more video and motion-design tools, such as:
  • Screen Studio
  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Adobe After Effects
  • Final Cut Pro
  • CapCut
  • Ability to transform raw screen captures into polished, premium social content
  • Strong understanding of visual hooks, including the ability to create compelling 0–3-second openings
  • Ability to navigate web applications, developer tools, and interactive prototypes to identify effective recording angles
  • Strong attention to capture quality, including smooth frame rates and clean footage without visible lag, stutter, glitches, or distracting interface elements
  • Ability to independently manage recording, editing, sound design, and final exports
  • Ability to deliver ready-to-post videos within a 24–48-hour turnaround after receiving a working prototype and creative brief

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience creating content specifically for X or other social media feeds
  • Experience producing viral or high-performing technology product content
  • Familiarity with AI applications, interactive tools, games, or early-stage web prototypes
  • Advanced motion graphics, sound-design, and visual-effects skills
  • Experience developing repeatable workflows for rapid video production
  • Experience with 2D or 3D animation, color grading, or compositing
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted creative production workflows

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Degree or formal training in video production, film, motion design, graphic design, digital media, or a related field is preferred
  • Professional experience creating technology-focused social video content is preferred
  • Professional portfolio of completed software demos, product videos, or technology sizzle reels is required
  • Demonstrated experience taking video projects from concept through final delivery is preferred

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement is not specified in the available job details
  • Must be able to work quickly and independently in a high-output creative environment
  • Must be comfortable working from functional prototypes and translating product capabilities into clear, visually engaging demonstrations
  • Must be able to provide two to three end-to-end software demos or technology sizzle reels as portfolio samples
  • Must be prepared to describe the tools and techniques used to elevate raw screen captures into premium social content
  • Must be able to commit to a 24–48-hour turnaround from receipt of a working prototype to delivery of a ready-to-post video

job.title: Procurement Operations Specialist
job.description:
Procurement Operations Specialist

Overview

Support critical procurement operations for a leading SaaS organization as a Procurement Operations Specialist. This contract role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who can manage purchasing requests, supplier and invoice follow-up, procurement tickets, and purchase order workflows while helping improve team efficiency through practical applications of artificial intelligence.

Working closely with procurement and cross-functional stakeholders, you will keep daily operations organized, responsive, and accurate while contributing to the adoption of approved AI tools and streamlined workflows.

Required Skills

  • Professional experience in procurement operations, purchasing, or a related function
  • Experience managing procurement requests and resolving service or support tickets
  • Knowledge of purchase orders, supplier coordination, invoice follow-up, and routine purchasing activities
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage ticket queues, documentation, and handoffs
  • High level of accuracy, responsiveness, and attention to detail
  • Experience using procurement, purchasing, or enterprise business systems
  • Practical experience with artificial intelligence tools or AI-enabled workflows
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Freshworks or a similar ticketing platform
  • Experience with Coupa or another procurement management system
  • Familiarity with ChatGPT or Claude
  • Experience reviewing contracts, statements of work, or business terms
  • Experience testing AI use cases, documenting workflows, or supporting AI adoption
  • SaaS industry experience
  • Familiarity with supplier onboarding, purchase requisitions, or procure-to-pay processes

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, procurement, finance, or a related field preferred
  • Prior experience in procurement operations, purchasing, accounts payable support, or supplier management preferred
  • Experience supporting process improvement or system implementation initiatives is beneficial

Other Requirements

  • Contract position expected to last approximately 3–4 months
  • Hybrid schedule with three days onsite each week: Tuesday through Thursday
  • Work location options: Austen, TX, or Waltham, MA
  • Candidates working from the Waltham location must be available during Eastern Time hours
  • Ability to work a full-time, 40-hour workweek
  • Target start date: December 1
  • Background check and drug screening required

job.title: AI Agent Engineer – Backend Focus
job.description:
AI Agent Engineer – Backend Focus

Overview

Build the next generation of intelligent business applications as an AI Agent Engineer – Backend Focus. This role is ideal for a hands-on backend engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience developing and deploying production-grade AI agents.

You’ll partner with product managers and domain experts to understand complex workflows, define success criteria, and transform business challenges into reliable agentic solutions. From designing multi-agent workflows and integrating tools to deploying scalable backend services and continuously improving production performance, you’ll own solutions from discovery through implementation and ongoing optimization.

Required Skills

  • Approximately 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on backend development and production systems.
  • Approximately 2+ years of hands-on experience building AI agents or agent-powered production applications using code.
  • Strong backend development experience with Python.
  • Experience building REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or similar frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • LLM APIs and SDKs
  • AI agent frameworks
  • Multi-agent orchestration
  • Tool calling
  • Context and state management
  • Agent execution workflows
  • Proven experience designing, developing, and deploying:
  • Production-grade backend services
  • REST APIs
  • External and internal integrations
  • Data models
  • Strong understanding of system design, API design, algorithms, data structures, access control, and scalable application architecture.
  • Experience building reliable agent workflows with retries, caching, error handling, evaluations, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop approvals.
  • Experience integrating AI agents with business systems, internal platforms, APIs, and external tools.
  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
  • Understanding of schema design, joins, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Experience with Git, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, production monitoring, and staged deployments.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.
  • Demonstrated ownership of solutions from requirements discovery and workflow design through deployment and production support.
  • Ability to communicate proactively, clarify requirements, collaborate with stakeholders, and work effectively through ambiguity.
  • Ability to measure and improve outcomes such as time saved, errors reduced, and process efficiency.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Frontend development experience with JavaScript ES6+ and React.
  • Experience using Claude Code or other AI-assisted development tools.
  • Experience with agent frameworks such as Google ADK or LangGraph.
  • Experience developing Electron-based desktop applications.
  • Knowledge of API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Basic DevOps experience, including Docker and CI/CD.
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit and integration tests.
  • Experience monitoring and optimizing AI agents with real users and measurable production outcomes.
  • Ability to determine when an AI agent is appropriate versus a simpler automation approach.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional background in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field is preferred; specific educational requirements were not provided.
  • Approximately 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial backend development.
  • Approximately 2+ years of experience building and deploying AI agents or agent-powered applications in production environments.

Other Requirements

  • Location: Palo Alto, CA.
  • Work arrangement: Remote or onsite status was not specified in the provided role details.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Duration: 3 months.
  • Start: ASAP.

job.title: Engineering Technician, Powertrain
job.description:
Engineering Technician, Powertrain

Overview

Join a hands-on hardware engineering team developing and testing advanced autonomous systems. As an Engineering Technician, Powertrain, you will build, modify, test, and troubleshoot complex electromechanical assemblies, wiring harnesses, printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs), and high-voltage powertrain hardware in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Your work will support prototyping, validation, system testing, and the development of reliable next-generation technology. This opportunity is ideal for a technically versatile, growth-minded professional who enjoys solving challenging hardware problems, collaborating with engineers, and turning test results into actionable improvements.

Required Skills

  • Demonstrated mid-to-high-level soldering proficiency, including:
  • Fine-pitch soldering
  • Surface-mount rework
  • Harness fabrication
  • Crimping and pinning
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering schematics, mechanical drawings, and wiring diagrams.
  • Experience building, reworking, and modifying electromechanical assemblies, wiring harnesses, and PCBAs.
  • Experience executing hardware tests and troubleshooting electrical systems.
  • Ability to use electrical measurement equipment, including multimeters and oscilloscopes.
  • Familiarity with command-line interface tools and engineering development environments used to configure, test, or troubleshoot hardware.
  • Ability to review test data and logs, conduct systematic root-cause analysis, and document findings clearly.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to following engineering documentation and test procedures.
  • Self-motivated, solution-oriented approach with the ability to take initiative in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and specialized hardware teams.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience testing high-voltage, high-power battery or powertrain systems.
  • Familiarity with surface-mount technology rework under magnification.
  • Experience building test fixtures, mechanical test rigs, or ground-support hardware.
  • Background in mechanical assembly, PCBA work, or complex hardware test operations.
  • Experience operating complex engineering tests and communicating clear, actionable results to engineering teams.
  • Experience in autonomous vehicles, aerospace, robotics, automotive, or hardware prototyping environments.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Hands-on experience in an engineering, automotive, aerospace, robotics, autonomous vehicle, or hardware prototyping environment.
  • Demonstrated practical proficiency with soldering, electrical testing, hardware troubleshooting, engineering documentation, and command-line or development tools.
  • Specific educational requirements were not provided.

Other Requirements

  • Location: Onsite/hybrid in the San Francisco Bay Area.
  • Employment Type: W2 contract-to-hire.
  • Duration: Initial six-month contract with potential for full-time conversion.
  • Ability to work in a hands-on engineering test and development environment.
  • Must be comfortable performing practical hardware work, including soldering, harness fabrication, assembly, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • High-voltage, high-power, and engineering test experience may be required for certain powertrain assignments.

job.title: Technical Program Manager — New Product Development (Hardware)
job.description:
Technical Program Manager — New Product Development (Hardware)

Overview

Lead the development of next-generation autonomous vehicle hardware from early concept and architecture through engineering builds and production ramp. As a Technical Program Manager, you will own end-to-end program execution for complex hardware products, coordinating teams across hardware, software, firmware, functional safety, systems engineering, procurement, and vehicle development.

You will translate strategic objectives into actionable roadmaps, schedules, milestones, and deliverables while partnering closely with internal engineering organizations and external contract manufacturers. Success in this role requires strong technical judgment, proactive risk management, clear communication, and the ability to influence outcomes across teams without formal authority.

This is an opportunity to help deliver challenging, highly integrated hardware systems in a fast-moving environment where structured program management and cross-functional collaboration are essential.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in hardware Technical Program Management or Engineering Program Management.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end hardware development experience, taking products from concept through:
  • Engineering Validation Test (EVT)
  • Design Validation Test (DVT)
  • Production Validation Test (PVT)
  • Production ramp
  • Strong hardware background with a bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline—or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working with outside contract manufacturers through development builds and production ramp.
  • Ability to coordinate complex programs across hardware, software, firmware, functional safety, systems engineering, procurement, and vehicle development teams.
  • Experience developing program schedules, product roadmaps, milestones, deliverables, and dependency plans.
  • Strong risk identification, mitigation, and issue-resolution skills, including the ability to drive actions to closure.
  • Ability to communicate program status, accomplishments, issues, and risks clearly and concisely to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Experience establishing standard program reports and maintaining clear visibility into progress and risks.
  • Proficiency with tools used to manage complex programs, such as JIRA and Gantt charts.
  • Ability to set agendas and facilitate key decisions that eliminate bottlenecks and minimize program risk.
  • Strong problem-solving, organizational, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to remain flexible and composed while working through rapid development cycles and uncertainty.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating across multiple cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to influence without formal authority and build strong working relationships with engineering teams, contract manufacturers, and senior leaders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • End-to-end hardware development experience in the automotive or consumer electronics industry at the system or subsystem level.
  • Direct management of two or more complete program development cycles involving hardware and software integration.
  • Technical Program Management experience supporting production programs during mass production and post-production sustaining phases.
  • Experience incorporating design-for-manufacturing and design-for-test feedback into hardware development.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional decisions involving engineering, finance, and strategy.
  • Strong references demonstrating the ability to build effective working relationships with senior leaders and engineers across functions and departments.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Six or more years of hardware Technical Program Management or Engineering Program Management experience.
  • Experience leading hardware programs through concept, architecture, EVT, DVT, PVT, and production ramp.
  • A master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering is a plus.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite.
  • Location: Foster City, California.
  • Employment type: W2 only.
  • Contract duration: 12 months.
  • Must be able to partner effectively with external contract manufacturers and cross-functional internal teams throughout hardware development and production ramp.
  • Must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and taking on a broad range of responsibilities as program needs evolve.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Project Manager – Professional Services

Overview

Lead complex customer engagements from kickoff through successful delivery and formal closeout. As a customer-facing Project Manager on a Professional Services team, you’ll guide implementation, migration, and professional services projects across technology and security solutions. You’ll manage a portfolio of 15–20 concurrent mid-size to large engagements, partnering with customers and cross-functional teams to maintain momentum, resolve issues, and deliver measurable results.

This role is ideal for a proactive, highly organized project leader who can balance strategic oversight with hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of project management experience, including 3+ years managing customer-facing projects in professional services, consulting, implementation delivery, technology, or SaaS environments
  • Experience managing 10+ concurrent projects with accountability for scope, schedule, budget, and customer satisfaction
  • Hands-on experience delivering projects under a Statement of Work (SOW) or Service Delivery Description (SDD)
  • Experience managing change requests, project financials, hours, burn rates, and forecasting
  • Working knowledge of waterfall, agile, and hybrid delivery methodologies, as well as PMI/PMBOK practices
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to engage customer stakeholders through the director level
  • Experience leading escalations and navigating difficult conversations with professionalism, urgency, and sound judgment
  • Proven ability to identify risks early, provide clear recommendations, and drive issues through resolution
  • Strong organizational skills and a proactive sense of ownership in an evolving environment
  • Technical literacy in networking and security concepts, such as DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS, and Zero Trust/SASE
  • Ability to understand technical discussions, migration dependencies, and project delivery risks
  • Proficiency with Jira, Salesforce, and a professional services automation (PSA) tool such as Certinia, Kantata, or ServiceNow SPM
  • Experience using Smartsheet or Microsoft Project
  • Ability to coordinate consultants, solutions engineers, account executives, customer success teams, support teams, partners, and customer stakeholders

Nice to Have Skills

  • PMP or CAPM certification
  • Agile certification, such as PMI-ACP, CSM, or SAFe
  • Professional services delivery experience with a cybersecurity, networking, or cloud provider
  • Experience migrating customers from competing CDN, security, or SASE vendors
  • Experience using AI tools to streamline project management activities, including status reporting and meeting documentation
  • Experience managing migration, cutover, and technology implementation risks

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, or a related field
  • Equivalent professional experience may be considered in place of a degree
  • 5+ years of project management experience, with a focus on customer-facing technology, SaaS, consulting, implementation, or professional services engagements

Other Requirements

  • Austin, TX is preferred; fully remote candidates may be considered
  • W2 engagement only
  • Availability to begin as soon as possible
  • Ability to manage a portfolio of 15–20 concurrent engagements from kickoff through formal closure
  • Ability to lead customer governance activities, including kickoff meetings, project plans, status reports, RAID logs, and executive updates
  • Ability to secure formal customer acceptance and sign-off for completed deliverables
  • Ability to maintain accurate project records and reporting across Jira, Salesforce, and PSA systems

job.title: Senior Financial Analyst
job.description:
Senior Financial Analyst – Corporate FP&A

Contract | Hybrid in Fairhaven, MA

Overview

Support high-impact Corporate FP&A initiatives in a project-based contract role focused on strengthening capital planning, capital allocation, and financial reporting processes. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will evaluate existing workflows, design standardized processes and governance, improve capital tracking, and develop management tools that help leaders make informed business decisions.

This opportunity is well suited for an analytical, independent finance professional who can manage complex deliverables, collaborate across business functions and regions, and identify opportunities to improve reporting and automation. Additional projects may include working capital, long-range planning, financial modeling, reporting automation, and broader finance process improvement initiatives.

Required Skills

  • Strong background in corporate FP&A or corporate finance
  • Experience with capital planning, capital allocation, or CAPEX management
  • Advanced financial modeling and Excel capabilities
  • Experience preparing financial reports and management reporting tools
  • Ability to assess existing processes and develop standardized workflows
  • Ability to independently manage project-based deliverables
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple business functions and regions

Nice to Have Skills

  • Power BI experience
  • Power Automate experience
  • Broader Microsoft 365 experience
  • Experience developing dashboards and management tools
  • Experience identifying opportunities for finance process automation
  • Background supporting working capital or long-range planning initiatives

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Prior experience in corporate FP&A, financial planning, corporate finance, or a related field
  • Experience leading or contributing to finance transformation, process improvement, capital management, or reporting projects
  • Educational requirements were not specified for this position

Other Requirements

  • Contract position with an initial estimated duration of 2+ months and potential for extension
  • Hybrid schedule based in Fairhaven, MA
  • Onsite presence required three days per week: Monday or Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday
  • Full-time schedule of 40 hours per week
  • Flexible start and end times
  • Availability to begin as soon as possible

job.title: AP Consultant
job.description:
AP Consultant (Part-Time, Fully Remote)

Overview

A rapidly growing technology organization is seeking an experienced AP Consultant to support expanding accounts payable volume and evolving accounting needs. This hands-on opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented accounting professional who can take ownership of day-to-day AP processing, expense management, and related accounting activities with minimal oversight.

Working fully remotely, you’ll collaborate with the accounting team to maintain accurate financial records, resolve discrepancies, and help strengthen AP processes in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. Additional hours and accounting projects may become available as business needs evolve.

Required Skills

  • Hands-on accounts payable experience, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment
  • Experience processing and coding vendor bills, credit card transactions, and employee reimbursements
  • Strong understanding of general ledger coding and transaction review
  • Ability to verify supporting documentation and maintain accurate AP records
  • Experience following up with employees and vendors to resolve missing receipts, invoices, and discrepancies
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned responsibilities
  • Proactive communication skills, including the ability to identify and escalate issues appropriately
  • Adaptability in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities
  • Ability to quickly learn company-specific accounting processes and software

Nice to Have Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Ramp
  • Experience with AP automation workflows and corporate card platforms
  • Experience with vendor onboarding, vendor statement reconciliation, payment processing, or AP aging review
  • Familiarity with expense management processes
  • Experience supporting additional accounting projects
  • Previous experience working in a startup or rapidly growing company

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Degree in accounting, finance, or a related field preferred
  • Proven experience in a full-cycle or high-volume accounts payable role
  • Experience supporting accounting operations within a technology or SaaS organization preferred

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Fully remote
  • Schedule: Part-time, typically 20–25 hours per week; hours may increase to 30–35 hours depending on workload
  • Duration: 3–6 months, with the possibility of extension
  • Start timing: Ideally available to begin within approximately two weeks
  • Additional ad hoc accounting projects may create opportunities for more hours
  • Must be comfortable independently managing AP responsibilities in a remote work environment

job.title: Tax Contractor (Indirect and International Tax) - Part Time
job.description:
Tax Contractor (Indirect & International Tax) – Part Time

Overview

A fast-growing, global consumption-based SaaS organization is seeking an experienced, hands-on Tax Contractor to strengthen its tax operations during a period of continued international growth. This role will focus primarily on indirect and international tax, including assessing sales and use tax, VAT, and GST exposure; coordinating required registrations; and ensuring customer contracts, order forms, and billing reflect appropriate tax treatment.

The contractor will also support domestic and international income tax compliance, year-end tax activities, audit preparation, and additional tax initiatives as needed. This is an opportunity for a Tax Manager or Senior Tax Manager to work independently, collaborate with finance and billing stakeholders, manage external tax advisors, and establish practical processes that can transition to a future permanent tax leader.

Part-time work is preferred, averaging approximately 20 hours per week, with flexibility based on project needs. Candidates available for full-time hours may also be considered.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience at the Tax Manager or Senior Tax Manager level
  • Strong indirect tax experience, including sales and use tax, VAT, and GST
  • Substantial international tax experience, including cross-border tax exposure assessments
  • Ability to evaluate whether tax registrations are required in additional jurisdictions
  • Experience coordinating country-specific registrations with external tax advisors
  • Knowledge of tax considerations in customer contracts, order forms, and billing, including:
  • Tax allocation
  • Gross-up provisions
  • Withholding language
  • Invoicing requirements
  • Experience supporting year-end tax compliance and tax-related audit requests
  • Experience with indirect tax filings, reconciliations, exemption certificates, tax notices, and related remediation activities
  • Ability to support refund claims, voluntary disclosures, and other corrective tax projects
  • Familiarity with international tax matters such as permanent establishment, withholding tax, and cross-border structuring
  • Ability to oversee outsourced R&D tax and transfer pricing projects
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working directly with transaction-level data and financial systems
  • Experience managing external tax advisors and translating recommendations into actionable next steps
  • Ability to work independently while building processes within an evolving internal tax function
  • Clear communication, strong organization, and the ability to manage multiple projects on a flexible schedule

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting a technology or SaaS organization with international operations
  • Familiarity with indirect tax considerations related to customer contracts and order forms
  • Experience with Anrok
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks Online, Rillet, and Stripe
  • Experience establishing tax calendars, documentation, controls, and repeatable processes
  • Experience supporting organizations preparing for public-company readiness

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Several years of progressive tax experience, including Tax Manager or Senior Tax Manager-level responsibilities
  • Demonstrated experience across indirect tax, international tax, tax compliance, and tax advisory projects
  • Relevant education or professional credentials in tax, accounting, finance, or a related discipline are beneficial; specific degree or certification requirements were not provided

Other Requirements

  • Schedule: Part-time preferred, averaging approximately 20 hours per week, with flexible scheduling based on project needs
  • Full-time consideration: Candidates available for full-time hours may also be considered
  • Engagement duration: Part-time work is expected to continue through February. Full-time engagements are expected to last approximately 1–2 months. Extensions may be possible based on project needs and the timing of a permanent tax hire.
  • Workload: Hours may be higher early in the engagement during the exposure assessment, registration activities, year-end work, and audit preparation, then taper as processes stabilize
  • Systems environment: The organization is transitioning from QuickBooks Online to Rillet; historical information and other project work may require access to QuickBooks Online
  • Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with internal finance, billing, and tax stakeholders, as well as external tax providers
  • Work arrangement: Remote, onsite, or hybrid expectations were not specified in the provided details
  • Scheduling consideration: Work should be planned around the organization’s scheduled closure from 12/21 through 01/03

job.title: Developer Productivity Engineer
job.description:
Developer Productivity Engineer

Overview

Help engineering teams unlock the full value of AI-powered development tools in this hands-on Developer Productivity Engineer role. You’ll serve as a trusted advocate for developers, supporting adoption of a coding AI platform, resolving user challenges, analyzing engagement data, and partnering with engineering and AI platform teams to improve the overall developer experience.

This role is ideal for a technically capable professional who enjoys working at the intersection of developer tools, AI enablement, technical support, analytics, and cross-functional collaboration. Rather than focusing solely on software development, you’ll help engineers successfully adopt emerging technologies and translate usage insights into measurable productivity improvements.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience supporting developer tools, engineering platforms, DevOps environments, or developer productivity initiatives
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience administering, supporting, or enabling developer-facing tools and platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding technologies, large language models (LLMs), and AI agents
  • Knowledge of AI coding tools and their application within software development workflows
  • Experience working with developer environments such as VS Code and related integrations
  • Programming experience in one or more of the following:
  • Python
  • Go
  • Java
  • Experience with dashboarding, analytics, or monitoring platforms such as Grafana or Kibana
  • Familiarity with Jira, ServiceNow, or similar ticketing and support systems
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple engineering teams
  • Ability to translate technical issues into clear, actionable solutions

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive awareness, onboarding, and adoption of AI-powered coding tools across engineering teams
  • Support installation, configuration, and ongoing usage of the platform
  • Serve as a primary support and escalation point for engineers using the platform
  • Troubleshoot user issues and coordinate with platform teams on complex technical problems
  • Create and maintain onboarding materials, FAQs, knowledge base articles, documentation, and training resources
  • Gather developer feedback and recommend improvements to the user experience
  • Track adoption, usage patterns, engagement, and platform effectiveness
  • Build dashboards and reporting solutions that provide visibility into key performance indicators and trends
  • Analyze usage data to identify adoption challenges and opportunities to improve developer productivity
  • Partner with engineering, product, and AI platform teams on bug resolution, feature requests, and enhancements
  • Communicate insights, trends, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership
  • Help ensure platform usage aligns with security, access management, and governance requirements

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience supporting internal engineering platforms at scale
  • Experience driving adoption of new developer technologies or enterprise tools
  • Strong customer service and relationship-management skills
  • Experience creating developer enablement programs, technical documentation, or training
  • Familiarity with platform governance, access management, or security requirements
  • Experience measuring business impact through adoption metrics and usage analytics
  • Curiosity about emerging AI technologies and their practical applications in software development
  • A proactive approach to identifying issues, improving processes, and delivering measurable outcomes

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline
  • Equivalent practical experience may be considered
  • Approximately 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in developer productivity, developer tools, engineering platforms, DevOps support, or a related area

Other Requirements

  • Contract position with an approximately 9-month duration
  • Hybrid role based in San Jose, California
  • Onsite attendance required three days per week
  • W2 employment only
  • Ability to work effectively with distributed engineering, product, and platform stakeholders
  • Strong interest in helping engineering teams adopt and benefit from AI-powered development tools

job.title: Treasurer
job.description:
Corporate Treasurer

Overview

Lead the treasury function for a complex, growing organization during a period of significant integration and operational change. The Corporate Treasurer will oversee global liquidity, banking relationships, credit facilities, foreign exchange exposure, working capital planning, insurance, and financial risk management.

This highly visible role will serve as a strategic advisor to the CFO and Board while ensuring the organization has the funding, controls, and risk protections needed to execute its business plans. The ideal candidate brings a strategic mindset, strong technical expertise, and the hands-on leadership needed to build scalable treasury processes across multiple entities, currencies, banks, and international operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own global cash management, daily cash positioning, liquidity reporting, and entity-level funding.
  • Lead the 13-week direct cash forecast and longer-range liquidity outlook by entity, currency, and use of cash.
  • Oversee payments, bank reconciliations, cash concentration, intercompany funding, and settlement activities.
  • Evaluate cash pooling, netting, repatriation, and other liquidity strategies while accounting for local restrictions.
  • Manage surplus cash in accordance with approved investment policies and counterparty limits.
  • Establish and execute the organization’s bank group strategy.
  • Manage banking relationships, account structures, KYC requirements, signatory mandates, service evaluations, RFPs, and fee negotiations.
  • Monitor bank and investment counterparty credit quality and exposure limits.
  • Develop and maintain the foreign exchange risk management policy.
  • Identify currency exposures and execute appropriate hedges, including forwards, swaps, options, spot conversions, and natural offsets.
  • Manage credit facilities, revolving and term arrangements, guarantees, surety, corporate cards, and other credit lines.
  • Monitor covenant compliance, lender reporting, collateral requirements, borrowing bases, fees, utilization, and available headroom.
  • Lead negotiations for new facilities, amendments, extensions, and refinancings.
  • Partner with FP&A, Procurement, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Operations, and program leadership on working capital planning.
  • Identify opportunities to improve payment terms, release cash, reduce funding needs, and optimize the cash conversion cycle.
  • Own the global corporate insurance program, including coverage evaluation, renewals, claims, broker and carrier management, and contractual requirements.
  • Report liquidity, funding, FX exposure, credit arrangements, insurance coverage, claims, and financial risk to executive leadership and relevant governance committees.
  • Build scalable treasury processes, controls, systems, and reporting to support continued growth and integration activities.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.
  • At least 10 years of progressive finance experience, including:
  • Five or more years in corporate treasury.
  • Three or more years in a leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing:
  • Global cash and liquidity across multiple entities and currencies.
  • Intercompany funding and cash movements.
  • Multi-bank relationships and banking structures.
  • Credit facilities, debt arrangements, covenants, and letters of credit.
  • Experience developing and executing foreign exchange hedging programs.
  • Knowledge of ISDA documentation, derivative accounting, and hedge effectiveness testing under ASC 815.
  • Strong cash forecasting, financial modeling, and working capital analysis skills.
  • Experience negotiating bank fees, cash management services, credit arrangements, and other treasury services.
  • Experience managing corporate insurance programs, including broker and carrier relationships, renewals, claims, and contractual insurance requirements.
  • Ability to develop and maintain treasury policies, approval workflows, segregation-of-duties processes, and fraud controls.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to present liquidity, funding, risk, and scenario analyses to executive and Board-level stakeholders.
  • Strategic, hands-on approach with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, integration-focused environment.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • MBA, Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), CFA, or equivalent advanced credential.
  • ARM, CPCU, or another risk management designation.
  • Experience with aviation, aerospace, products liability, or other specialty insurance programs.
  • Background in a public, high-growth, capital-intensive, manufacturing, or long-lead supply chain organization.
  • Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions or transaction integration.
  • Knowledge of cross-border cash restrictions, repatriation, cash pooling, netting, and international banking operations.
  • Experience implementing or improving treasury management systems and bank connectivity, including SWIFT, host-to-host, or API integrations.
  • Familiarity with supply chain finance, trade finance, alternative risk financing, or captive insurance structures.
  • Experience operating within SOX-compliant treasury control environments.

Preferred Education and Experience

The preferred candidate will hold a bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related discipline and bring at least 10 years of finance experience, including substantial leadership experience in corporate treasury. Candidates should have a proven record of managing global cash, banking relationships, FX exposure, credit facilities, corporate insurance, working capital, and financial risk for a multi-entity organization.

An MBA, CFA, CTP, ARM, CPCU, or similar credential is advantageous.

Other Requirements

  • Work arrangement: Onsite, hybrid, or remote options available.
  • Engagement: Five months or longer, with potential for contract-to-hire.
  • Start timing: Expected to begin between mid-November and early December 2026.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across domestic and international entities, currencies, banks, lenders, and business functions.
  • Strong discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential financial, banking, lending, insurance, and transaction-related information.

job.title: Technical PM
job.description:
Technical Program Manager – Site Implementations

Overview

Lead complex, high-impact technology implementations that bring integrated parking solutions to life at new and existing sites. As the Technical Program Manager, you will own each deployment from discovery and kickoff through design, permitting, installation, software configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and operational handoff.

This field-oriented role brings together software, customer-facing hardware, networking, construction, vendors, field teams, and customer operations. You will establish repeatable implementation standards, coordinate cross-functional delivery, manage site readiness, and ensure every launch meets approved scope, quality standards, acceptance criteria, and operational requirements.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Five or more years of experience leading complex technology implementations involving software, customer-facing hardware, networking, vendors, and physical site work.
  • Demonstrated ownership of multiple site deployments from initial planning through go-live.
  • Experience managing:
  • Permitting and inspections
  • Construction and site-readiness dependencies
  • Vendor schedules and contractor commitments
  • Procurement, shipping, and equipment installation
  • Quality assurance and customer acceptance
  • Strong working knowledge of software delivery, integrations, defect management, release readiness, and production support.
  • Ability to interpret implementation plans, site drawings, technical requirements, test results, and project financial information well enough to identify gaps and drive decisions.
  • Experience coordinating internal teams, customers, hardware vendors, software teams, utilities, permitting authorities, construction partners, low-voltage contractors, and field installers.
  • Experience managing risks, issues, assumptions, decisions, scope changes, budget impacts, dependencies, and recovery plans.
  • Ability to coordinate functional testing, integration testing, field acceptance testing, user acceptance testing, defect remediation, launch approval, and post-launch support.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, organization, risk management, and executive status-reporting skills.
  • Ability to travel regularly to implementation sites and support critical milestones outside normal business hours when required.

Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience

  • Experience with parking technology, access control, kiosks, point-of-sale systems, building systems, EV charging, security systems, telecommunications, or other distributed hardware and software environments.
  • Experience with Parking Access and Revenue Control Systems.
  • Familiarity with payment systems, license plate recognition, parking guidance, enforcement, mobile applications, or revenue optimization products.
  • Experience supporting implementations at municipalities, hospitals, hotels, universities, mixed-use properties, airports, or other active customer sites.
